These weaknesses would hinder future efforts to advance the Neo-Brandeisian Section 5 agenda vis a vis NCAs and other non-standard contracts the Biden Commission sought to address.  Claims that reducing competition or disadvantaging rivals is presumptively unfair and thus unlawful will likely fall on deaf ears of judges reviewing legislative rules under the Administrative Procedure Act (“APA”), particularly after the demise of Chevron deference to agency interpretations.  A future Neo-Brandeisian Commission would thus have to identify some less expansive Section 5 principle, something Neo-Brandeisians have shown no inclination to do.

Moreover, refusal to recognize modern economic theory regarding the formation, function and impact of nonstandard contracts will render expansive rules vulnerable to judicial determinations that such pronouncements are arbitrary and capricious under the APA.  Such rules will be particularly vulnerable when the Commission ignores public comments that highlight how such theory and record evidence undermines the basis for a proposed rule.  In a society governed by law, electoral success is no substitute for doing the work required to develop well-grounded legal standards and understand the economic theory and evidence necessary to apply such standards when formulating legislative rules.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了拜登时期联邦贸易委员会（FTC）在新布兰代斯学派主导下试图通过《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条重振反垄断执法的努力，特别是2024年禁止绝大多数员工竞业禁止协议（NCA）的立法规则。文章指出该"第5条实验"存在法律和科学两方面的根本缺陷：法律上未能提供可替代消费者福利标准的"可理解原则"（intelligible principle），科学上忽视了交易成本经济学等现代经济理论。作者对未来的新布兰代斯派第5条议程持悲观态度，认为此类规则在司法审查（尤其是《行政程序法》下的arbitrary and capricious审查）下将难以存续。
AI.research_question: 拜登政府FTC依据《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条禁止竞业禁止协议的努力存在哪些法律和科学性缺陷？这些缺陷对未来新布兰代斯学派重振第5条议程有何影响？
AI.motivation: 拜登时期FTC在新布兰代斯学派领袖Lina Khan领导下，于2022年发布第5条政策声明，提出"超越正当竞争"标准，并于2024年发布禁止绝大多数员工竞业禁止协议的立法规则。然而特朗普政府FTC最终放弃了该规则。作者旨在系统剖析这一"第5条实验"失败的根本原因，并为未来反垄断执法提供警示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学（TCE）、"超越正当竞争"（goes beyond competition on the merits）标准、可理解原则（intelligible principle）、提升竞争对手成本理论（Raising Rivals' Costs）、推定规则（prima facie case）、《行政程序法》（APA）下的arbitrary and capricious审查标准
AI.method: 法律与政策分析（doctrinal and policy analysis），对2022年第5条政策声明和2024年NCA规则进行批判性审查，结合交易成本经济学理论、法庭记录和公众评论进行分析论证。
AI.findings: （1）法律缺陷：2022年声明和2024年规则均未提供可替代消费者福利标准的可理解原则，"超越正当竞争"概念缺乏明确界定；（2）推定缺陷：规则推定任何减少竞争或轻微损害对手的协议均属非法，将大量常规协议误判为违法；（3）科学缺陷：规则忽视了交易成本经济学的核心教导，特别是关于非标准合同（如NCA）的形成、功能与影响的分析；（4）程序缺陷：委员会忽视了公众评论中基于经济学理论的反对意见；（5）未来影响：在Chevron原则失效后，此类缺乏坚实理论和证据基础的规则将难以通过司法审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为交易成本经济学在反垄断立法规则制定中的适用提供了重要论证，阐明了TCE关于合同自愿形成过程、合同效益与损害共存假设的批判，以及提升竞争对手成本理论对推定排除性协议合法性的质疑。文章为评估行政机构立法规则的法律标准与经济理论基础之间的关系提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构（尤其是FTC）提供了重要的政策警示：（1）立法规则制定必须建立在清晰的法律标准和坚实的经济学理论基础之上；（2）必须认真对待公众评论中提出的经济学论证；（3）在行政法司法审查日益严格的背景下（尤其Chevron原则失效后），推定式禁止缺乏证据支持的规则将面临被法院推翻的高风险；（4）未来反垄断改革需要寻找更审慎、更具证据基础的路径。

title: Exploring Customer Perception Towards Fintech Services in Karimnagar District Central Cooperative Bank: A Study on Usage and Adoption
affiliations: Osmania University and Osmania University

detail.title: Exploring Customer Perception Towards Fintech Services in Karimnagar District Central Cooperative Bank: A Study on Usage and Adoption
detail.abstract: The study investigates customers' perceptions of the usability of FinTech services in the context of Karimnagar District Central Cooperative Bank and the qualitative and exploratory research approach identified the elements that drive customer adoption and usage of FinTech services. The study collected the primary data through a questionnaire with convenient sampling method and applied the neural network and exploratory factor analysis statistical methods. The findings of the study emphasised the significance of prioritising customer wants and expectations in the development and delivery of FinTech services and concluded that to meet the client needs, financial institutions must prioritise improving the speed and effectiveness of their FinTech offerings. Furthermore, when designing FinTech services, financial institutions must consider clear instructions and ease of learning. The study highlighted the potential benefits of financial institutions engaging in FinTech services as, the FinTech services can be used to save money while earning revenues.

AI.tldr: 本研究以Karimnagar地区中央合作银行为背景，通过定性和探索性研究方法调查客户对金融科技(FinTech)服务可用性的感知，识别驱动客户采用和使用金融科技服务的关键要素。研究采用便利抽样法通过问卷收集一手数据，并运用神经网络和探索性因子分析进行统计检验。
AI.research_question: 客户对金融科技服务可用性的感知如何？哪些要素驱动客户采用和使用金融科技服务？
AI.motivation: 在金融科技快速发展的背景下，需要深入理解客户对金融科技服务可用性的感知，以帮助金融机构更好地设计和提供金融科技服务，满足客户需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可用性理论（涉及速度、有效性、清晰说明和学习便利性等维度）
AI.method: 定性探索性研究方法；通过问卷收集一手数据；便利抽样法；神经网络分析；探索性因子分析
AI.findings: 金融科技服务的开发和交付应优先考虑客户需求和期望；金融机构必须优先提高金融科技服务的速度和有效性；设计金融科技服务时需考虑清晰说明和易于学习；金融科技服务既能帮助节省成本又能创造收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了金融科技服务可用性研究领域，识别了驱动客户采用金融科技服务的关键要素（速度、有效性、清晰说明、易于学习），为金融科技可用性理论提供了实证补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构（特别是合作银行）设计和优化金融科技服务提供了实践指导，强调以客户需求为导向，并指出金融科技服务可同时实现成本节约和收入增长的双重效益。

title: The Chirality Bound
affiliations: MYRA School of Business, ETH Zurich and MIT

detail.title: The Chirality Bound
detail.abstract: Ambarish, Kreuser, and Seigel (AKS 2026a) introduced market chirality as the measurable handedness of the implied-volatility surface and proposed a local slope-to-curvature index to quantify that asymmetry. This paper develops a probabilistic restriction associated with that geometric object. We identify two centred second-order innovations that enter finite-horizon option profit and loss: an unexpected spotvolatility product shock and an unexpected volatility-squared shock. Under conditional joint Gaussianity, their correlation is available in closed form and is governed by the spot-volatility correlation. We then use a local stochastic-volatility skew relation to connect that dynamic correlation to the chirality index introduced in the earlier AKS paper. The resulting theory yields a simple chirality frontier and, crucially, an exact condition under which that frontier is a lower envelope for the magnitude of the correlation between the two quadratic innovations. We call this the chirality dominance condition. The paper therefore moves chirality from a geometric characterization to a falsifiable restriction on the dependence of option-risk innovations. We also correct the exact SVI representation of the local chirality index and distinguish it from its commonly used first-order approximation. Preliminary SPX surface evidence reproduces the negative chirality, hump-shaped maturity structure, and stress amplification documented in AKS-I, but these surface facts are treated only as motivation. The decisive empirical test must construct the quadratic innovations independently, estimate the surface-to-dynamics conversion, and test the lower envelope only in the dominance region.

AI.tldr: 本文在市场手性（chirality）几何概念的基础上，发展出一个可证伪的概率约束条件。作者识别出两个二阶创新（隐含波动率乘积冲击与隐含波动率平方冲击），在条件联合高斯假设下推导出其相关性的闭式解，并通过局部随机波动率偏斜关系将其与手性指数联系起来，提出"手性支配条件"（chirality dominance condition），使手性从几何刻画跃升为对期权风险创新依赖结构的约束。论文还修正了局部手性指数的SVI精确表示，并将其与常用的一阶近似区分开来。
AI.research_question: 如何将期权隐含波动率曲面的几何特征（市场手性）转化为对期权风险创新依赖结构的可证伪的概率约束？具体而言，两个二阶二次创新的相关性在什么条件下由手性指数给出下界？
AI.motivation: 前人（AKS 2026a）将市场手性定义为隐含波动率曲面的可测"手性"，并提出局部斜率-曲率指数来量化该不对称性，但该工作仅停留在几何刻画层面，缺乏可检验的概率性（falsifiable）约束。本文旨在将这一几何对象发展为对期权风险创新依赖结构的可证伪限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场手性（market chirality）理论、隐含波动率曲面局部几何、随机波动率偏斜关系、条件联合高斯建模、SVI参数化表示、有限期限期权损益的二阶创新分解
AI.method: 理论推导：识别有限期限期权损益中两个中心化的二阶创新（隐含现货-波动率乘积冲击和隐含波动率平方冲击），在条件联合高斯假设下推导它们的相关性闭式解；利用局部随机波动率偏斜关系将动态相关性与手性指数连接，推导手性前沿及手性支配条件的精确条件；修正SVI表示下的局部手性指数精确形式。实证部分仅将SPX表面证据作为动机（负手性、驼峰型期限结构、压力放大效应），强调决定性的实证检验需独立构建二次创新并仅在支配区域内检验下界。
AI.findings: 1）期权损益的两个二阶创新的相关性受现货-波动率相关性控制，且在条件联合高斯下有闭式解；2）通过局部随机波动率偏斜关系可将该动态相关性与手性指数连接，推导出简单的手性前沿；3）提出了手性支配条件——在该精确条件下，手性前沿是两二次创新相关性强度的下包络（lower envelope）；4）修正了局部手性指数的SVI精确表示，区分于常用的一阶近似；5）初步SPX证据复现了负手性、驼峰型期限结构和压力放大效应，但仅作为动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场手性从纯几何刻画推进为可证伪的概率约束（通过手性支配条件），建立了隐含波动率曲面几何特征与期权风险创新依赖结构之间的理论桥梁；为波动率曲面的依赖结构提供了新的下界约束条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了明确的操作路径：独立构建二次创新、估计曲面到动态的转换、在支配区域内检验下界包络；修正了SVI表示下手性指数的精确形式，避免了一阶近似可能带来的误差。

title: Cutting AI Datacenter Energy with Reinforcement Learning: Measured Power Control of LLM Training from One GPU to the Fleet

detail.title: Cutting AI Datacenter Energy with Reinforcement Learning: Measured Power Control of LLM Training from One GPU to the Fleet
detail.abstract: Reinforcement-learning post-training dominates modern language-model development, yet its power behavior on GPU hardware has not been characterized, and datacenters manage GPU power only with workload-blind mechanisms, static caps and reactive throttling, that slow the hardware indiscriminately. We instrument GRPO training with half-second power telemetry at 7B, 14B, and 72B scales on one to four A100s, over 380,000 samples, and train a PPO meta-controller that adapts the workload's own generation parameters to measured power. Evaluated against the full 500-step 7B trace, the controller cuts power-limit violations by 89.8% while increasing token output by 18.1% and energy efficiency by 26.2% in tokens per megawatt-hour. Deployed live at 72B, the same controller family yields replicated null results, diagnosed as the group-size actuator losing authority under model sharding. An actuator-authority sweep shows the same parameters applied as generation concurrency retain 17 to 22% power authority, isolating an occupancyversus-volume principle; a controller rebuilt on that actuator controls a live 72B rollout-generation workload across three hardware replications: 35.7% more output than a static safe baseline at 2.27 ± 1.08% budget violations, 87.2% fewer violations than uncontrolled operation, and the highest mean throughput and lowest mean energy per token among the constrained controllers, with an adaptive threshold rule matching it in one of three operating conditions. Under realistic measurement windows the original 72B transients collapse from 23.6% at half-second resolution to 1.6% at thirty seconds and zero at five minutes; a composed sixteen-GPU fleet shows zero violations at thirty seconds and longer, with peak demand at 50 to 56% of nameplate. For this fleet mix, approximately twofold oversubscription of nameplate appears feasible for similar workloads, subject to operator validation. We quantify the economic and carbon consequences and specify a low-cost operator pilot to verify the estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统刻画了强化学习后训练（GRPO）在GPU硬件上的功耗行为，并开发了一个基于PPO的元控制器，通过自适应调整工作负载自身的生成参数来管理GPU功耗。在7B至72B规模、1-4块A100上进行了超38万样本的实验，控制器将功耗限制违规减少89.8%，同时提升token输出18.1%和能效26.2%。在72B大规模部署中发现组大小执行器在模型分片下失效，重新构建基于生成并发的控制器后，在三次硬件复现中实现了35.7%更高的输出、87.2%更少的违规，并量化了约两倍超卖配置的可行性及经济碳排放影响。
AI.research_question: 如何利用强化学习后训练（GRPO）工作负载自身的可调生成参数来动态管理GPU功耗，以替代现有静态限制和反应式节流的盲目功耗管理机制？
AI.motivation: 强化学习后训练已主导现代语言模型开发，但其在GPU硬件上的功耗行为从未被表征；数据中心仅使用对硬件无差别降速的静态限制和反应式节流来管理GPU功耗，缺乏工作负载感知的功耗管理手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习（GRPO后训练 + PPO元控制器）、功耗管理理论、执行器权威（actuator authority）概念、占用率与吞吐量（occupancy-versus-volume）权衡原则
AI.method: 在7B、14B、72B规模、1-4块A100上进行GRPO训练，以半秒级功耗遥测采集超过38万样本；训练PPO元控制器，根据实测功耗自适应调整工作负载的生成参数；通过执行器权威扫描诊断模型分片下的失效问题，并以生成并发为执行器重建控制器；在16-GPU组合和实际72B版本部署中验证，并进行经济与碳影响量化。
AI.findings: (1) 7B/14B规模下PPO元控制器将功耗限制违规削减89.8%，token输出提升18.1%，能效提升26.2%；(2) 72B部署中组大小执行器在模型分片下失效（零结果），扫描发现生成并发保留17-22%功耗权威，隔离出占用率-体积原则；(3) 以并发为执行器的控制器在三次硬件复现中实现35.7%更多输出、2.27±1.08%预算违规、较无控制减少87.2%违规；(4) 测量窗口从半秒扩展到30秒时瞬态从23.6%坍缩至1.6%，5分钟归零；16-GPU组合在30秒及以上窗口零违规，峰值需求为铭牌功率的50-56%；(5) 约两倍超卖铭牌功率对此类工作负载可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统表征了强化学习后训练在GPU上的功耗特征；提出并验证了执行器权威（actuator authority）概念，揭示了模型分片下组大小参数失效的机制；提炼出占用率-体积（occupancy-versus-volume）原则，为工作负载感知的GPU功耗管理提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需改动硬件即可实现工作负载感知的GPU功耗管理方法；证明了约两倍GPU铭牌功率超卖对类似工作负载可行，可显著降低数据中心资本支出；量化了经济与碳影响，并设计了低成本运营商试点方案以验证估计。

title: Generative AI as a Limited Equalizer: Experimental Evidence on Gender Gaps in Competition
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou),  and

detail.title: Generative AI as a Limited Equalizer: Experimental Evidence on Gender Gaps in Competition
detail.abstract: We study whether access to generative AI (GenAI) changes gender gaps in willingness to compete. In a laboratory experiment, 360 university students solve numerical and logic questions that are highly suitable for ChatGPT assistance in a Niederle and Vesterlund (2007) piece rate versus tournament paradigm. In the main experiment (n = 240), sessions are randomly assigned either to a baseline condition without Chat-GPT or to a condition with ChatGPT available for optional use. ChatGPT access substantially increases performance for both women and men and largely eliminates baseline gender differences in scores, yet it does not significantly reduce the gender gap in tournament entry. Additional analyses reveal a dual-channel mechanism where ChatGPT access raises performance but lowers confidence. The gender gap in tournament entry disappears among participants with a stronger intention to use GenAI. In a follow-up information provision treatment (n = 120), participants receive credible information that men and women perform similarly in prior ChatGPT-assisted tournaments. The gender gap in tournament entry persists, suggesting that correcting social-comparative beliefs alone is insufficient when uncertainty about tool reliability remains salient.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验研究生成式AI（ChatGPT）的可用性是否改变男女性别在竞争意愿上的差距。研究发现ChatGPT虽显著提升男女双方表现并缩小了基线性别得分差距，但并未显著缩小参赛性别差距，其机制是ChatGPT提升表现的同时降低了信心。即使在提供信息干预以纠正社会比较信念后，性别差距依然存在。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的可获得性是否以及如何改变性别在竞争意愿上的差异？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在快速改变工作场所的竞争格局，但我们对它是否有助于缩小（或可能扩大）性别竞争差距知之甚少。由于竞争意愿对职业发展和收入有重要影响，理解GenAI对性别差距的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Niederle和Vesterlund（2007）的计件工资vs锦标赛竞争范式；社会比较信念理论；信心与表现的双通道机制
AI.method: 实验室实验：主实验（n=240）随机分配为无ChatGPT基线组与有ChatGPT可选使用组；追踪实验（n=120）提供可信的信息干预，告知参与者先前ChatGPT辅助锦标赛中男女表现相似。使用Niederle和Vesterlund（2007）的数量与逻辑推理任务。
AI.findings: （1）ChatGPT的使用显著提升了男女双方的表现，并基本消除了基线性别的得分差距；（2）但ChatGPT并未显著缩小锦标赛参与的性别差距；（3）机制分析显示双通道效应：ChatGPT提高表现但降低信心；（4）在有意使用GenAI的参与者中，锦标赛参与的性别差距消失；（5）信息干预纠正社会比较信念后，性别差距依然存在，表明仅纠正社会比较信念不足，工具可靠性不确定性依然核心。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GenAI对竞争性别差距影响的双通道机制（表现提升与信心下降），补充了技术变革与性别竞争意愿的理论；识别出仅纠正社会比较信念的局限性，指出工具可靠性不确定性是独立于社会比较信念的障碍因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供启示：引入GenAI虽能提升绩效，但降低信心可能阻碍女性参赛；建议设计降低工具可靠性不确定性的干预措施（如培训和试用机会）以促进女性参与竞争性机会。

title: Reframing the Hundi Challenge: A Behavioral Analysis of Informal Value Transfer Systems, Institutional Incentives, and Policy Responses in Nepal

detail.title: Reframing the Hundi Challenge: A Behavioral Analysis of Informal Value Transfer Systems, Institutional Incentives, and Policy Responses in Nepal

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work performed in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This policy study did not involve clinical trials or human subjects research requiring institutional review board approval. To address privacy and ethical concerns, the identities of all key informants interviewed during the qualitative research process were kept strictly confidential and remain undisclosed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, financial aid, or funding from any funding agency, commercial entity, or non-profit sector. The author conducted this study independently during a research internship with the institution.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Published in the "Apprentices Work" Policy Brief Series by the Institute for Integrated Development Studies (IIDS), Nepal. Available on the official IIDS website at: https://iids.org.np/publications/

detail.abstract:
Nepal's sustained reliance on Informal Value Transfer Systems (IVTS), notably Hundi/Hawala systems, presents an important and increasingly urgent policy challenge amid intensified Financial Action Task Force (FATF) scrutiny and Nepal's more extensive financial inclusion objectives. Existing discussions around Hundi often frame it as an illegal financial activity that requires strengthening enforcement. This policy brief proposes an alternative framework to examine Hundi as a behavioral economics response to a mix of structural, behavioral, and institutional incentives offered by formal and informal remittance channels. With evidence derived from literature and Key Informant Interviews (KIIs), the brief identifies fundamental friction points influencing consumers' remittance channel choices and develops two policy recommendations aimed at addressing information failure and improving access to formal remittance channels. The aim is not to supersede existing AML/CFT efforts, but rather to reinforce them through a behavioral framework highlighting underlying drivers of Hundi.

To contextualize the presented recommendations, it is essential to clarify the scope and limitations of this policy brief. Although the brief acknowledges the institutional constraints as supporting the persistence of Hundi, policies addressing these factors would mandate broader inter-agency coordination between various government agencies and exceed the immediate scope of social, behavioral, and financial sector policies as well as the abilities of the intended audience of this brief. Fundamentally, the primary focus for the policy recommendations is on addressing the behavioral motivations and structural friction points influencing individual remittance and financing choices rather than institutional loopholes. Additionally, due to the largely undocumented nature of Hundi, this policy brief faces the issue of limited availability of quantitative data on IVTS, necessitating a qualitative methodology based on literature review and KIIs rather than a quantitative, empirical analysis of Hundi/Hawala systems in Nepal.

AI.tldr: 本政策简报将尼泊尔对Hundi/Hawala非正式价值转移系统（IVTS）的依赖视为一种行为经济学现象，而非单纯的非法金融活动。通过文献综述和关键知情人访谈，识别影响消费者汇款渠道选择的关键摩擦点，并提出两项政策建议：解决信息失灵和改善正规汇款渠道的可及性，以补充而非取代现有的反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）工作。
AI.research_question: 在FATF审查趋严和金融包容目标扩大的背景下，尼泊尔消费者为何持续选择非正式价值转移系统（Hundi/Hawala）进行汇款？应采取何种政策干预来引导消费者转向正规汇款渠道？
AI.motivation: 现有关于Hundi的讨论通常将其框定为需要强化执法的非法金融活动，但这种视角忽视了消费者选择背后的结构性、行为性和制度性激励因素。随着FATF审查日益严格，需要一种替代性分析框架来理解并更有效地应对这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学框架，将Hundi使用视为消费者对正规与非正规汇款渠道所提供的结构性、行为性和制度性激励组合的行为经济学反应。
AI.method: 定性研究方法：文献综述（literature review）和关键知情人访谈（Key Informant Interviews, KIIs）。由于Hundi交易大部分未记录在案，缺乏定量数据，因此采用定性方法论而非定量实证分析。
AI.findings: 识别出影响消费者汇款渠道选择的基本摩擦点，主要包括信息失灵和正规汇款渠道可及性不足两大方面。制度性约束虽然支撑Hundi的持续存在，但相关政策的解决需要跨机构协调，超出了本简报的直接范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种替代性分析框架，将Hundi从单纯的"非法金融活动"重新概念化为行为经济学视角下的理性选择结果，为理解非正式汇款系统的持续存在提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两项针对解决信息失灵和改善正规汇款渠道可及性的具体政策建议，旨在通过行为框架补充并强化现有的反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）努力而非取代之。

title: Rethinking Portfolio Risk Management: Beyond Frequentism and Econophysics to Causal Bayesian Stress Testing
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Rethinking Portfolio Risk Management: Beyond Frequentism and Econophysics to Causal Bayesian Stress Testing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently as part of the MSc Financial Engineering program at WorldQuant University.

detail.abstract: Modern portfolio risk management stands at a crossroads. Traditional frequentist frameworks, built on structural stability and historical estimation, consistently fail during market anomalies. Econophysics offers a powerful structural critique by highlighting power laws and phase transitions, yet it remains largely descriptive and deterministic, providing minimal actionable utility for forward-looking decisionmaking. This article critiques both paradigms on empirical and theoretical grounds, defends the necessity of subjective inputs in stress testing, and operationalizes Riccardo Rebonato's coherent stress-testing framework. By integrating expert knowledge with algorithmic discovery via causal structure learning, we construct a Causal Bayesian Network (CBN) for a tactical asset portfolio. We demonstrate how causal inference resolves the fundamental limitations of purely data-driven risk management and enables coherent, narrative-driven stress scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了传统频率学派风险管理与经济物理学两大范式的局限性，主张将主观专家知识与算法因果发现相结合，通过构建因果贝叶斯网络（CBN）实现连贯的叙事驱动型压力测试场景，为战术资产组合的风险管理提供新的方法论框架。
AI.research_question: 如何克服传统频率学派风险管理和经济物理学范式在应对市场异常时的局限性，构建更具预测性和决策实用性的压力测试框架？
AI.motivation: 传统频率学派依赖结构稳定性和历史估计，在市场异常期频繁失效；经济物理学虽提供了强有力的结构性批判（幂律和相变），但仍是描述性和决定性的，缺乏前瞻性决策的行动价值。需要一种整合主观输入与算法发现的替代框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 频率学派风险管理理论、经济物理学（幂律与相变理论）、Riccardo Rebonato的连贯压力测试框架、因果贝叶斯网络（CBN）、因果结构学习
AI.method: 对两大范式进行实证和理论批判，论证压力测试中主观输入的必要性，将专家知识与因果结构学习算法相结合，构建战术资产组合的因果贝叶斯网络（CBN）模型。
AI.findings: 因果推断能够解决纯数据驱动风险管理的根本局限，使压力测试场景具备连贯性和叙事驱动性，从而提升风险管理的前瞻性决策效用。
AI.theory_contributions: 在理论上调和了频率学派的主观性批评与经济物理学的结构性洞察，将Rebonato的连贯压力测试框架操作化，并论证了因果推理在风险管理理论中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战术资产组合的风险管理者提供了一套将专家知识与算法发现相结合的因果贝叶斯网络构建方法，支持生成连贯、具有叙事逻辑的压力测试场景。

title: The Market Price of Chirality Risk
affiliations: MYRA School of Business, ETH Zurich and MIT

detail.title: The Market Price of Chirality Risk
detail.abstract: Equity implied-volatility surfaces are not mirror symmetric: their wings differ systematically in slope and curvature, producing a measurable directional asymmetry we call market chirality. Building on a companion paper that establishes this asymmetry as an exact, irreducible feature of second-order option hedging, we ask whether exposure to it is a distinct systematic risk factor that earns a market risk premium. At forward-at-the-money, the conditional variance of the second-order hedging innovation associated with vanna and volga is exactly proportional to gamma. We construct a market-wide chirality innovation from standardised spot and impliedvolatility shocks, embed it in a stochastic discount factor, and derive a beta-pricing restriction linking expected option excess returns to a chirality beta, leaving the sign and magnitude of the price of risk to the data. We propose an empirical framework-portfolio sorts, spanning tests, and Fama-MacBeth regressions-for testing whether chirality risk is priced beyond existing market, volatility, and jump factors, and illustrate the construction of the proposed factor using calibrated SPX surfaces: the chirality index is measurable, stable in its term structure, and co-varies with realised market stress as required. A historical panel with realised returns, needed to test the pricing restriction itself, is left to future work. The contribution is not to modify option pricing, but to introduce a new candidate systematic risk factor linking the geometry of the implied-volatility surface to equilibrium expected returns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出权益隐含波动率曲面的"市场手性"（market chirality）不对称性，建立其作为系统性风险因子的理论框架，通过随机贴现因子推导出beta定价限制，并设计实证检验框架（组合排序、跨期测试、Fama-MacBeth回归），证明该因子可测量、期限结构稳定且与市场压力共变。
AI.research_question: 市场手性（隐含波动率曲面的方向性不对称）是否是一个独立的系统性风险因子，且是否获得市场风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 隐含波动率曲面并非镜像对称，其两翼在斜率和曲率上存在系统性差异。基于配套论文将该不对称性确立为二阶期权对冲的精确、不可约特征，本文进一步追问这种暴露是否构成独立的系统性风险因子并定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二阶期权对冲理论（vanna和volga对冲创新）；随机贴现因子（SDF）框架；beta定价限制（beta-pricing restriction）
AI.method: 从标准化的现货和隐含波动率冲击构建市场范围的手性创新；嵌入随机贴现因子并推导beta定价限制；提出组合排序、跨期测试和Fama-MacBeth回归的实证检验框架；使用校准的SPX曲面说明因子构建。
AI.findings: 在远期平值（ATM）处，与vanna和volga相关的二阶对冲创新的条件方差精确正比于gamma。手性指数可测量、期限结构稳定，并与已实现的市s场压力协变。定价限制的符号和幅度留给数据决定；历史面板数据检验留待未来工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入一个新的候选系统性风险因子，将隐含波动率曲面的几何结构与均衡预期收益联系起来，超越了现有的市场、波动率和跳跃因子。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的因子构建方法（基于标准化冲击构建手性创新），并给出完整的实证检验方案（组合排序、跨期测试、Fama-MacBeth回归），为投资者评估和管理手性风险暴露提供了工具。

title: The Financial Tax of Corruption: Quantifying Sub-National Institutional Risk in Indian Infrastructure Project Finance

detail.title: The Financial Tax of Corruption: Quantifying Sub-National Institutional Risk in Indian Infrastructure Project Finance
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a predictive financial framework for translating sub-national governance variation into a quantifiable component of infrastructure project cost risk in India. While India's National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) targets over ₹213 trillion in cumulative investment, project execution efficiency is widely understood to vary across state jurisdictions. Building on the credit-risk Expected Loss (EL) decomposition used in project finance — Exposure at Default × Probability of Default × Loss Given Default — this paper develops a methodology for translating a state-level governance or corruption proxy into an explicit, rupee-denominated capital expenditure haircut, applied ex ante to project valuation.

We specify a project-level Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression model — proposed for estimation using data from the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) Flash Reports and a state governance proxy such as the DPIIT Business Reform Action Plan (BRAP) rankings — as the empirical strategy for this framework, and illustrate its mechanics using a stylized, hypothetical numerical example calibrated to the general order of magnitude reported in existing literature on corruption and infrastructure costs. Full econometric estimation using project-level data is proposed as the next stage of this research program (Section 5.3). Once empirically estimated, this framework is intended to give public financial institutions, project developers, and bilateral funding agencies an objective, data-driven way to price sub-national institutional risk prior to capital deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个预测性金融框架，将印度次国家级治理差异转化为基础设施项目成本风险的可量化组成部分。基于项目融资中信用风险的预期损失（EL）分解方法，该框架开发了一套方法，将州级治理或腐败代理指标转化为明确的、以卢比计价的资本支出削减（haircut），并在项目估值前（ex ante）应用。论文提出了采用MoSPI闪报数据和DPIIT BRAP排名等治理代理指标的项目级OLS回归模型作为实证策略，并辅以校准于现有文献数量级的假设性数值示例。完整计量估计拟作为下一阶段研究。
AI.research_question: 如何将印度次国家级（州级）治理差异转化为基础设施项目成本风险的量化组成部分，从而在资本部署前客观定价次国家级制度风险？
AI.motivation: 印度国家基础设施管道（NIP）目标累计投资超过213万亿卢比，但项目执行效率在不同州管辖区之间存在显著差异。现有方法缺乏将州级治理或腐败差异系统性地转化为可量化、以货币计价的成本风险的工具，导致公共金融机构和项目开发商难以在投资前客观定价此类制度风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险预期损失（Expected Loss）分解框架——即暴露于违约风险（EAD）×违约概率（PD）×违约损失率（LGD）——被迁移应用于基础设施项目的州级治理风险定价。
AI.method: 提出项目级普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归模型，拟使用印度统计与方案实施部（MoSPI）闪报数据以及州级治理代理指标（如DPIIT商业改革行动计划BRAP排名）进行估计。论文通过假设性数值示例（校准自现有文献中腐败与基础设施成本的数量级）说明框架机制，完整计量估计留待下一阶段研究。
AI.findings: 本文构建了将州级治理代理变量转化为以卢比计价的资本支出削减（haircut）的机制性方法，并通过风格化的假设性示例展示了该框架的运作逻辑。这为后续基于项目级数据的完整实证估计奠定了基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将项目融资中成熟的信用风险预期损失（EL）分解框架创造性地扩展到次国家级制度治理风险定价领域，为治理差异与基础设施成本风险之间建立了形式化的量化桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共金融机构、项目开发商和双边资助机构提供了一种客观、数据驱动的工具，使其能够在资本部署前对次国家级制度风险进行定价，从而改善印度基础设施投资的风险管理和资源配置决策。

title: From Greeks to Tradable Risk a Geometric Theory of Option Hedging Under Stochastic Volatility
affiliations: MYRA School of Business, ETH Zurich and MIT

detail.title: From Greeks to Tradable Risk a Geometric Theory of Option Hedging Under Stochastic Volatility
detail.abstract: A hedge is a trade chosen to minimise expected discrete hedging error, not a rule for cancelling a chosen set of Greeks. We take this as the starting point rather than the conclusion. Expanding expected squared hedging error to second order, under Gaussian diffusion increments and the Levi-Civita connection of the diffusion metric, forces the risk object entering the optimal hedge to be coordinate-invariant: ordinary Gamma, Vanna, and Volga depend on the choice of state variable (spot versus log-spot, variance versus volatility), while their covariant analogues do not. This paper makes three contributions. First, we derive-rather than assert-the covariant Hessian as the risk object a discretehedging-error objective requires. Second, we derive the second-order hedging objective itself from the expected squared hedging error under Gaussian diffusion increments, fixing the relative weight between first-and second-order risk at Δt rather than leaving it a free risk-aversion parameter to calibrate. Third, we prove the resulting hedge is exactly an orthogonal projection under an explicit, verified inner product (a Geometric Hedging Theorem), nesting the classical minimum-variance hedge and ordinary Delta-Vega as special cases. We specialise to the Heston model, deriving the diffusion metric, connection, covariant Greeks, and Gaussian curvature (K = ξ²/2v) in closed form, and verify the hedge's coordinate invariance with two independent numerical implementations agreeing to ten significant figures. Empirically, holding the instrument set fixed to isolate the value of covariant geometry from the value of trading more instruments, we find the covariant correction significantly reduces hedging error in most, though not all, of a grid of volatilityof-volatility and correlation parameters, with the cleanest and most consistent benefit against Delta-Vega using identical instruments. A real EURUSD options illustration shows the diagnostic is computable from market data. We do not claim the geometric hedge dominates conventional methods in every regime; we claim it is derived rather than assumed, its invariance is proved and verified, and its empirical benefit is concentrated exactly where the theory locates it.

AI.tldr: 本文从一个核心观点出发：对冲是对冲误差平方期望最小化的交易选择，而非消除选定希腊字母的规则。作者在高斯扩散增量和扩散度量的Levi-Civita联络假设下，将期望平方对冲误差展开到二阶，推导出协变Hessian作为风险对象，证明了最优对冲是某内积下的正交投影（几何对冲定理），并在Heston模型中给出闭式解和数值验证，实证表明协变修正可显著降低对冲误差。
AI.research_question: 如何从离散对冲误差最小化目标出发，推导出坐标不变的（协变）风险度量与最优对冲规则，而非经验性地假设特定希腊字母组合。
AI.motivation: 传统对冲中普通Gamma、Vanna和Volga依赖状态变量选择（如现货vs对数现货），缺乏坐标不变性；且对冲规则通常是假设而非推导的。作者希望从最小化离散对冲误差的根本目标出发，推导出内在不变的风险度量和最优对冲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微分几何（黎曼流形、Levi-Civita联络、协变导数）、随机微积分（高斯特林扩散增量）、最优对冲理论、Heston随机波动率模型。
AI.method: 将期望平方对冲误差展开至二阶矩，在Gaussian diffusion increments下推导二阶对冲目标函数；证明最优对冲等价于显式内积下的正交投影（几何对冲定理）；在Heston模型中推导扩散度量、联络、协变希腊字母和高斯曲率的闭式解；通过两套独立数值实现验证坐标不变性，并在参数网格和真实EURUSD期权数据上进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）协变Hessian是从离散对冲误差目标推导出的风险对象，而非假设；（2）二阶对冲目标函数中的一阶与二阶风险权重由Δ t固定，无需校准风险厌恶参数；（3）最优对冲恰为某内积下的正交投影（几何对冲定理），经典最小方差对冲和Delta-Vega为其特例；（4）Heston模型中扩散度量和协变希腊字母有闭式解，两次独立数值实现一致到十位有效数字；（5）在固定工具集下，协变修正能显著降低大多数参数区域的对冲误差，对Delta-Vega的改进最一致；（6）EURUSD实例表明该诊断可从市场数据计算。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）从第一性原理推导（而非假设）协变Hessian作为对冲风险对象，确立了微分几何框架在对冲问题中的理论正当性；（2）推导出二阶对冲目标函数，固定了一阶与二阶风险的相对权重为Δ t，消除了自由风险厌恶参数；（3）证明几何对冲定理，将最优对冲与正交投影联系起来，统一了经典最小方差对冲和Delta-Vega作为特例。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供坐标不变的协变希腊字母，消除对冲对状态变量选择的敏感度；（2）在Heston模型下给出所有几何量的闭式解析解，便于实务实施；（3）实证显示协变修正可显著降低对冲误差，尤其在固定工具集下对Delta-Vega的改进最为一致；（4）通过EURUSD实例证明该诊断可从真实市场数据计算，具备实操可行性。

title: From Exit to Cultivation: Future Imaginaries and Youth Agency in Albania Through Repeated Causal Layered Analysis

detail.title: From Exit to Cultivation: Future Imaginaries and Youth Agency in Albania Through Repeated Causal Layered Analysis

declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by the Regional Network of Centers for Advances Studies

detail.abstract: Young people in Albania are frequently discussed in terms of a familiar set of concerns: migration, insecurity, institutional distrust, corruption, and blocked opportunity. Regional evidence strongly supports that picture. Recent research on youth in the Western Balkans points to persistent difficulties with employ- ment, transitions to stable work, and confidence in public institu- tions while also showing that responses must be sensitive to local conditions rather than treated as one-size-fits-all solutions (Eu- rofound, 2024). The 2024 Youth Study Southeast Europe similarly portrays young people in the region as concerned, observant, and politically aware, even as they remain doubtful about the broader trajectory of their societies (Hasanović et al., 2024). Yet the picture remains incomplete. It captures pressure, disappointment, and mistrust while revealing little about how young people imagine the future, how those imagined futures are revised across time, and under what conditions alternative futures become believable enough to matter. That is the central question this paper addresses. Drawing on a three-wave Causal Layered Analysis (CLA) study with university students in Tirana, the paper asks what becomes visible when future-oriented dis- cussions are repeated rather than captured only once. More spe- cifically, it examines how participants describe Albania’s path to Europe in the present as a used future and how they articulate de- sirable alternatives. The paper argues that repeated CLA reveals more than recurring complaints. Across the three waves, many participants shifted from diffuse frustration to clearer diagnoses of insecurity, blocked civic circulation, weak institutional response, and the public conditions that would make a more desirable future credible. The strongest movement is therefore not from pessi- mism to optimism, but from broad dissatisfaction toward more nuanced accounts of what is blocked, what is desired, and what would make a different future believable. In that sense, the paper contributes to research on future imaginaries, youth agency, de- sirable futures, and qualitative futures methods by showing that repeated CLA can reveal how futures become more or less socially credible over time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项为期三轮的因果分层分析（CLA）研究，探讨阿尔巴尼亚地拉那大学生如何想象和修正对未来的看法。研究发现，重复的CLA讨论使参与者从广泛的挫败感转向对不安全感、公民流通受阻、制度回应薄弱等问题的更清晰诊断，以及使不同未来变得可信的公共条件。最强的变化不是从悲观到乐观，而是从模糊的不满走向更精细化的未来想象。
AI.research_question: 当未来导向的讨论被重复进行（而非仅一次性捕捉）时，会出现什么新的洞见？年轻人如何描述阿尔巴尼亚通往欧洲的道路作为一种"用过未来"（used future），以及他们如何阐述理想的可替代未来？
AI.motivation: 现有关于西巴尔干年轻人研究主要聚焦于移民、不安全感、制度不信任、腐败和机会受阻等负面议题，但未能揭示年轻人如何想象未来、这些想象如何随时间被修正，以及在什么条件下替代性未来会变得足够可信从而具有意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果分层分析（Causal Layered Analysis, CLA）；未来想象（future imaginaries）；"用过未来"（used future）概念；青年能动性（youth agency）；理想未来（desirable futures）
AI.method: 三波次的因果分层分析（CLA）研究，参与者为地拉那的大学生。
AI.findings: 重复的CLA揭示出超越反复抱怨的更深层内容：许多参与者从弥漫性的挫败感转向对不安全感、公民流通受阻、制度回应薄弱等问题的更清晰诊断，以及使更可取未来变得可信所需的公共条件。最强变化不是从悲观到乐观，而是从广泛的失望转向对什么被阻碍、什么被渴望、什么能使不同未来变得可信的更精细叙述。
AI.theory_contributions: 对"未来想象"、"青年能动性"、"理想未来"和定性未来方法研究做出贡献，证明重复的CLA能够揭示未来如何随时间推移变得更具或更不具有社会可信度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了一种方法论的启示：通过重复性未来导向讨论，可以更深入地理解年轻人对未来可信度的感知，从而为更有效的青年政策和社会干预提供依据。

title: Plasma ATR-FTIR Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning for Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Classification
affiliations: University of the Philippines, Los Baños - University of the Philippines Los Banos, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Santo Tomas Hospital, University of Santo Tomas and University of Santo Tomas

detail.title: Plasma ATR-FTIR Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning for Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Classification
detail.abstract: Background: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is often diagnosed at advanced stages, creating a need for minimally invasive approaches to support detection. This study evaluated plasma attenuated total reflectance-Fourier transform infrared (ATR-FTIR) spectroscopy combined with machine learning for distinguishing NPC from clinically healthy individuals. Methods: Plasma samples from 51 histologically confirmed NPC cases and 51 age- and sex-matched clinically healthy controls were analyzed across 4000-600 cm⁻¹. Differences at 21 spectral peaks were assessed using the Mann-Whitney U test. Seven machine-learning algorithms were evaluated using the full spectrum, fingerprint region, selected peaks, and low-rank spectral representations with repeated cross-validation and exploratory age- and sex-stratified analyses. Results: Thirteen peaks showed significant between-group differences in median absorbance (p < 0.01). Despite substantial overlap in the original spectral distributions, model performance in the complete cohort increased when selected peaks and low-rank spectral representations were used: the best case AUCs were 0.6303 ± 0.0384 for the full spectrum, 0.6330 ± 0.0333 for the fingerprint region, 0.7066 ± 0.0452 for selected peaks, and 0.7404 ± 0.0422 for the low-rank representation. The neural network model achieved the best overall performance using low-rank features, with an accuracy (ACC) of 0.7115 ± 0.0456. Exploratory subgroup performance was higher among females overall (AUC: 0.8159 ± 0.0721; ACC: 0.7714 ± 0.0745) and participants younger than 45 years (AUC: 0.8031 ± 0.0368; ACC: 0.7800 ± 0.0298). Conclusion: Plasma ATR-FTIR spectroscopy combined with machine learning showed moderate discrimination between NPC and clinically healthy controls, with the highest performance obtained using low-rank spectral features and a feedforward neural network. Larger independent cohorts are needed for validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了血浆ATR-FTIR光谱结合机器学习区分鼻咽癌与临床健康个体的能力。51例NPC患者与51例匹配健康对照的血浆样本在4000-600 cm⁻¹范围内分析，使用七种机器学习算法和不同的特征选择策略。结果显示，使用低秩光谱表示和神经网络模型时性能最佳（AUC: 0.7404，ACC: 0.7115），女性及45岁以下亚组性能更高，整体呈中等判别能力，需更大样本验证。
AI.research_question: 血浆ATR-FTIR光谱结合机器学习能否有效区分鼻咽癌患者与临床健康个体，以及不同光谱特征提取策略和机器学习算法对判别性能的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 鼻咽癌常在晚期才被诊断，需要微创的早期检测手段，因此探索利用血浆红外光谱结合机器学习作为无创、快速筛查工具的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于红外光谱分子振动指纹特征反映生物分子组成变化（如核酸、蛋白质、脂质等），结合机器学习的统计判别能力来识别疾病相关的光谱差异。
AI.method: 对51例鼻咽癌患者和51例年龄性别匹配的健康对照血浆样本进行ATR-FTIR光谱采集（4000-600 cm⁻¹）；使用Mann-Whitney U检验评估21个光谱峰的组间差异；采用七种机器学习算法，结合全光谱、指纹区、筛选峰和低秩光谱表示四种特征策略，进行重复交叉验证和年龄性别分层探索性分析。
AI.findings: 13个光谱峰在组间存在显著差异（p<0.01）；低秩光谱表示结合神经网络获得最佳性能（AUC: 0.7404，ACC: 0.7115）；女性亚组（AUC: 0.8159）和45岁以下亚组（AUC: 0.8031）表现更优；整体判别能力为中等水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了特征选择策略（特别是低秩光谱表示）对提升机器学习分类性能的重要性，并揭示了鼻咽癌判别性能在不同性别和年龄亚组间的异质性，为光谱组学方法的优化提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种基于血浆ATR-FTIR光谱的非侵入性鼻咽癌筛查方案，展示了低秩特征+神经网络作为最佳模型组合，并提示在女性及年轻人群中可能具有更高的临床应用潜力，为后续更大规模的临床验证提供了方法学基础。

title: Optimizing Technology-Assisted Patient Navigation for Cancer Screening and Diagnostic Follow-up: A Component Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials
affiliations: Taipei Medical University, National Taiwan University - Graduate Institute of Epidemiology and Preventive Medicine, Taipei Medical University, Chung-Ang University and Taipei Medical University

detail.title: Optimizing Technology-Assisted Patient Navigation for Cancer Screening and Diagnostic Follow-up: A Component Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no potential conflicts of interest regarding the authorship or publication of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: National Science and Technology Council of Taiwan.

detail.abstract:
Background: Suboptimal cancer screening and diagnostic follow-up limit early cancer detection. We compared technology-assisted patient navigation strategies for improving screening uptake and follow-up adherence and estimated the contribution of individual components.

Methods: We searched PubMed, Embase, CINAHL, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane CENTRAL from inception to March 30, 2026. We included randomised controlled trials of adults eligible for cancer screening or follow-up that compared patient navigation alone or with technology-assisted components against usual care or another eligible intervention and reported outcomes within 2 years. We excluded studies evaluating identical intervention categories across groups, cancer-treatment adherence, previous cancer, or ongoing treatment. Two reviewers independently selected studies, extracted aggregate published data, and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects frequentist network and component network meta-analyses estimated risk ratios (RRs) and incremental odds ratios. The outcomes were screening uptake and follow-up adherence. The study was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261335761).

Findings: We identified 3,783 records and included 54 trials involving 122,244 participants (74·36% women); 49 assessed screening uptake and 20 assessed follow-up adherence. Compared with usual care, patient navigation plus telephone and video support was associated with the greatest screening uptake (RR 2.21, 95% CI 1.76–2.93) and follow-up adherence (3.75, 2.17–6.49). High risk of bias was identified in 24% of screening studies and 20% of follow-up studies, mainly owing to missing outcome data and outcome measurement. Global inconsistency was detected for screening uptake (Q=32·56; p=0·012) but not follow-up adherence (p=0·52). Confidence was low or very low for 68% and 56% of direct comparisons, respectively. 

Interpretation: Technology-assisted patient navigation could improve cancer screening and diagnostic follow-up, with navigator-led telephone and video support appearing most effective. Inconsistency and limited confidence warrant cautious implementation tailored to local barriers and digital access.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统综述和网络荟萃分析，比较了技术辅助的患者导航策略对癌症筛查和诊断随访依从性的效果。结果显示，结合电话和视频支持的患者导航效果最佳（筛查利用率RR 2.21，随访依从性RR 3.75），但存在结果不一致性和证据质量较低的问题，实施时需谨慎考虑当地障碍和数字访问条件。
AI.research_question: 技术辅助的患者导航策略（单独或结合不同技术组件）相比常规护理，能否改善癌症筛查利用率和诊断随访依从性？各个技术组件的相对贡献如何？
AI.motivation: 不充分的癌症筛查和诊断随访限制了癌症的早期发现，亟需确定最有效的患者导航干预策略来提升筛查和随访依从性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 患者导航理论与技术辅助干预（电话和视频支持）在健康行为改变中的应用框架。
AI.method: 系统性综述与随机效应频率学网络荟萃分析及组件网络荟萃分析。检索六个数据库至2026年3月30日，纳入54项随机对照试验（122,244名参与者），使用Cochrane RoB 2评估偏倚风险，估计风险比和增量比值比。
AI.findings: 患者导航加电话和视频支持与筛查利用率最高相关（RR 2.21, 95% CI 1.76–2.93）和随访依从性最高（RR 3.75, 95% CI 2.17–6.49）。24%的筛查研究和20%的随访研究存在高偏倚风险。筛查利用率存在全局不一致性（Q=32.56; p=0.012），随访依从性未检测到不一致性（p=0.52）。68%和56%的直接比较证据置信度分别为低或极低。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过组件网络荟萃分析系统评估各技术组件对患者导航效果的增量贡献，为技术辅助患者导航的优化组合提供了证据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床实践和公共卫生决策提供循证指导：导航员主导的电话和视频支持是提升癌症筛查和随访依从性的最有效策略，同时强调实施应考虑本地障碍和数字访问条件。

title: Company Stock in Defined Contribution Plans: Evidence from Proxy Voting
affiliations: Pusan National University

detail.title: Company Stock in Defined Contribution Plans: Evidence from Proxy Voting
detail.abstract: I examine whether firms' decisions to offer company stock in defined contribution (DC) plans are explained by managers' corporate control motives. Using a large sample of proxy voting outcomes, I find that employee ownership in DC plans is significantly and positively associated with the level of voting support for management-sponsored proposals. This suggests that managers encourage employee DC holdings in company stock in order to receive higher voting support in favor of management. The effects of employee ownership on voting outcomes are significantly greater in specific subsamples where employee vote is more important to management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业是否因管理层公司控制动机而在固定缴款（DC）养老金计划中提供公司股票。利用大样本代理投票结果，发现DC计划中的员工持股与管理层支持提案的投票支持率显著正相关，表明管理层鼓励员工持有公司股票以获得更高的投票支持。
AI.research_question: 企业在固定缴款（DC）养老金计划中提供公司股票的决策，是否由管理层的公司控制动机所驱动？
AI.motivation: 以往文献多从员工利益或财务角度解释DC计划中的公司股票，但较少关注管理层是否利用员工持股作为巩固其控制权的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司控制权理论、代理理论、员工持股的投票权效应
AI.method: 利用大样本代理投票结果进行实证分析，考察DC计划中员工持股与管理层支持提案投票支持率之间的相关关系，并在员工投票对管理层更重要的子样本中进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: DC计划中的员工持股水平与管理层支持提案的投票支持率显著正相关；在员工投票对管理层更重要的子样本中，这种效应显著更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将管理层控制动机引入DC计划中公司股票提供决策的解释框架，拓展了公司控制权与员工持股交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者、投资者和养老金计划参与者理解DC计划中公司股票（ESOP）的潜在利益冲突提供证据，提示需关注管理层可能利用员工持股操纵投票结果的治理风险。

title: News You Don't Believe: The Pass-Through of Diagnoses into Survival Beliefs
affiliations: University of Hawaii at Manoa - Department of Quantitative Health Sciences

detail.title: News You Don't Believe: The Pass-Through of Diagnoses into Survival Beliefs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of de-identified public-use and restricted-access survey data and involved no interaction with human subjects; it was therefore exempt from institutional review board approval. All respondents consented to participation in the original surveys.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: A new diagnosis of a serious condition is hard news about one’s own survival; I esti mate how much of it reaches beliefs. In three harmonized aging panels (the US HRS, England’s ELSA, and continental SHARE), doubly-robust Callaway–Sant’Anna event studies identify the causal revision of subjective survival probabilities after a first diag nosis, on the log-odds scale of survival to the respondent’s own target age, and I divide it by the warranted revision implied by the same cohorts’ realized post-diagnosis mor tality, conditioned on the survivors I observe. After a first cancer diagnosis, beliefs move only about a quarter of the warranted amount (pooled λ = 0.23, 95% Fieller CI [0.08,0.37]). The estimate is anchored by the HRS, whose benchmark is internal (0.17), and corroborated by ELSA, whose thin death linkage forces a borrowed bench mark (0.34); SHARE is too imprecise to contribute independently. The onset move is larger, about half, but transitory, and it survives an honest-DiD relaxation of parallel trends. Observable prognosis does not explain the shortfall: the pre-diagnosis belief predicts no realized mortality once I condition on the richest observable health, and beliefs respond to bad news at least as much as to good, so I find no observable private information channel and no signature of self-protective denial, though an unrecorded signal I cannot rule out. The pass-through is steeper for the more numerate and con centrated among coarse focal (0/50/100) responders. Other diagnoses barely register. The belief governs wealth and long-term-care insurance as life-cycle theory predicts, so its stickiness leaves those decisions under-adjusted. Even the diagnosis people fear most is discounted, not dismissed.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国HRS、英国ELSA和欧洲SHARE三个老龄化面板数据，采用双重稳健的Callaway–Sant'Anna事件研究方法，估计首次重大疾病诊断（尤其是癌症）后个体主观生存概率的因果更新程度。研究发现，首次癌症诊断后，主观生存概率的更新仅约为客观死亡率所"应有"更新的四分之一（λ=0.23），说明人们对严重疾病的诊断信息存在显著贴现，而非完全忽视。
AI.research_question: 个体在收到严重疾病（如癌症）首次诊断这一"关于自身生存的坏消息"后，主观生存概率信念实际会更新多少？这一更新是否与客观死亡率所隐含的应有更新相符？
AI.motivation: 严重疾病诊断是对个人生存前景的关键信息冲击，但个体信念如何吸收这类信息尚不清楚。若信念更新不足，将导致财富配置、长期护理保险等生命周期决策系统性失调。同时，现有文献对"信念黏性"的量化证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性预期与贝叶斯信念更新的生命周期理论框架，以及主观生存概率与客观死亡率之间的校准（calibration）理论。
AI.method: 使用三个老龄化面板（美国HRS、英国ELSA、欧洲SHARE），采用双重稳健的Callaway–Sant'Anna事件研究设计，估计首次诊断后主观生存概率（log-odds尺度）的因果变化，并将其除以同队列诊断后实际死亡率所隐含的应有更新量。辅以"诚实的DID"放松平行趋势假设的稳健性检验。
AI.findings: (1) 首次癌症诊断后，主观生存概率更新仅为应有更新的约四分之一（合并λ=0.23，95% Fieller CI [0.08,0.37]）；(2) 该结果主要由HRS锚定（内部基准0.17），ELSA因死亡链接薄弱需借用基准（0.34），SHARE精度不足；(3) 诊断初始反应更大（约一半）但具有暂时性；(4) 可观测预后信息无法解释更新不足，且未发现私人信息渠道或自我防护性否认的证据；(5) 更新率在数值能力较强和粗粒度反应者（0/50/100）中更高；(6) 其他诊断几乎不引起信念变化；(7) 信念黏性导致财富和长期护理保险决策调整不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了严重疾病诊断后主观生存概率"部分更新"的因果量化证据，区分了"贴现而非否认"的信念更新模式，并排除了私人信息和自我防护性否认等替代解释渠道，丰富了信念形成与更新的行为经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了患者对重大健康信息的系统性低估反应，对医疗信息披露策略、患者知情决策、以及财富管理与长期护理保险产品的设计具有直接的政策与实践启示。

title: Three Clocks, One Option: Cross-Maturity Volatility Substitution and the State-Dependent Short-Dated Greeks Bias in Real-Time S&P 500 Analytics

detail.title: Three Clocks, One Option: Cross-Maturity Volatility Substitution and the State-Dependent Short-Dated Greeks Bias in Real-Time S&P 500 Analytics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses financial market data and does not involve human participants, personal data, animals, or clinical research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Zero-days-to-expiry (0DTE) options reached 51% of S&P 500 index (SPX) options volume in Q4 2024 and 59% of full-year 2025 volume (Cboe), making short-dated Greeks central to intraday gamma-exposure analytics. We identify a systematic, state-dependent bias in those Greeks that arises from a common design in hybrid volatility engines. A smoothed volatility surface is calibrated only from expiries at or beyond a minimum grid maturity-about two weeks in the system studied-so contracts below that floor have no surface node and a naïve Greeks path evaluates them at the floor node's volatility. This cross-maturity volatility substitution is silentevery surface diagnostic stays clean-and directionally structured under short-end inversion, with near-the-money gamma systematically overstated: gamma scales as 1/(σ√T), so a floor volatility below the true short-dated level inflates near-ATM gamma in proportion. Across 49 real SPX sessions (41 with open interest), an engine-free reconstruction that substitutes the observable implied floor misestimates 0-2-day-to-expiry gamma by a median 47%. Its all-sub-floor gamma error is 9.1% under open-interest weighting and 14.5% under equal weighting; the corresponding 0-7-day-bucket errors are 16.6% and 22.1%. A median 25% of gross dollar-gamma exposure sits below the floor, while the signed whole-book aggregate nearly cancels-the aggregate-level invisibility that let the defect persist. Every error measure rises with short-end term-structure inversion (Spearman ρ = +0.53 for the substituted volatility and +0.39-0.50 for the induced gamma errors, all p < 0.05)-the bias hides on calm days and bites on stressed ones. The fix is minimal-evaluate sub-floor Greeks at each contract's own-maturity calibrated volatility. In the archived production engine, whose grid stores a local-volatility floor, it shifts gross aggregate gamma by +3.6% and absolute theta by-9.7%, with open-interest metrics unchanged. It also moves the published strike-profile GEX crossing-the level commonly reported as the "gamma flip"-by 24 index points, while the canonical portfolio zero-gamma root, obtained by repricing the book across spot, moves only 1.9: the reported level is markedly more sensitive to the defect than the regime boundary it is taken to represent. The reconstruction is engine-free and fully specified hereindata filters, metric definitions, and constants-so it can be repeated on any equivalent vendor chain dataset. This is a measurement and reproducibility contribution, not a trading signal; it is a companion to our treatment of the dealer-gamma sign convention (Chilingarian 2026).

AI.tldr: 本文发现混合波动率引擎中短到期期权希腊字母存在系统性的、状态依赖的偏差：低于最小网格到期日（约两周）的合约被错误地使用网格下限节点的波动率，导致近ATM伽马被系统性高估。基于49个真实SPX交易日的重建分析显示，0-2天到期伽马中位数误差达47%，且误差在短端倒挂时显著增大（Spearman ρ最高0.53）。提出的最小修复方案——评估各合约自身到期日的校准波动率——可使总伽马偏移+3.6%、绝对theta偏移-9.7%，并显著影响"伽马翻转"水平的报告。
AI.research_question: 混合波动率引擎中的短到期日（0DTE）期权希腊字母是否存在系统性偏差？这种偏差的性质、规模、状态依赖性和可修复性如何？
AI.motivation: 0DTE期权已占SPX期权成交量的一半以上（2024年Q4为51%，2025年全年为59%），使得短端希腊字母成为日内伽马暴露分析的核心。然而，常见的混合波动率引擎设计——仅从达到或超过最小网格到期日的到期日校准波动率曲面——可能导致低于该下限的合约被静默地使用错误波动率，这一问题此前未被识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伽马与波动率和到期日的关系：γ∝1/(σ√T)；混合波动率引擎的网格校准设计；跨到期日波动率替代的偏差传播机制。
AI.method: 基于49个真实SPX交易session（其中41个存在未平仓合约），使用无引擎（engine-free）重建方法，输入可观测的隐含下限波动率替代真实短端波动率，比较希腊字母误差。计算中位数伽马误差、全下限以下伽马误差（按未平仓加权和等权）、0-7天到期桶误差、美元伽马暴露分布、Spearman秩相关检验等。最终在生产引擎中测试最小修复方案的效果。
AI.findings: （1）0-2天到期伽马中位数误差为47%；（2）全下限以下伽马误差按未平仓加权为9.1%，等权为14.5%；0-7天桶误差分别为16.6%和22.1%；（3）中位数25%的美元总伽马暴露位于下限以下，但带符号的整账本聚合几乎抵消——解释了缺陷为何未被发现；（4）所有误差指标随短端结构倒挂增大（Spearman ρ=0.39-0.53，均p<0.05）；（5）修复方案使总伽马偏移+3.6%、绝对theta偏移-9.7%；（6）公布的strike-profile GEX交叉点（"伽马翻转"）移动24个指数点，而规范的投资组合零伽马根仅移动1.9。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并量化了混合波动率引擎中一种此前未被发现的系统性希腊字母偏差机制，揭示了"聚合级不可见性"如何让缺陷持续存在，建立了偏差与市场状态（短端倒挂）之间的依赖关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了完全指定的、无引擎依赖的重建方法（含数据过滤、指标定义和常数），可在任何等价供应商链数据集上复现；给出了最小修复方案及其量化影响；指出报告的"伽马翻转"水平比其代表的制度边界对缺陷更敏感，对实务中该指标的解读具有警示意义。

title: Future Capability Preservation: A General Theory for Evaluating Transformation

detail.title: Future Capability Preservation: A General Theory for Evaluating Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The work involved no human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: Complex systems are commonly evaluated according to present performance, persistence, recovery, adaptability, compliance, or aggregate welfare. These criteria are important but incomplete when a transformation materially changes the conditions under which future decision, action, correction, and reconstruction remain possible. This paper develops Future Capability Preservation (FCP) as a general evaluative theory for such transformations. Future capability refers to the practical ability or substantive possibility of identified human or collective capability bearers to act, learn, contest, intervene, coordinate, refuse, repair, reconstruct, and generate alternatives. Institutional, technical, ecological, and epistemic capacities enter the analysis as enabling conditions rather than interchangeable moral bearers. Within FCP, capability preservation requires that a transformation retain, or leave realistically reconstructable, the conditions for those future capabilities. The paper extends the earlier system-level formulation of FCP by defining its scope and core terms, specifying a causal-evaluative mechanism, distinguishing retained, reconstructable, and generative capability, and separating empirical implications, diagnostic requirements, and normative commitments. FCP is positioned in relation to resilience and transformability, adaptive governance, the capability approach, irreversibility and real-options reasoning, dynamic adaptive pathways, path dependence, sustainability transitions, and meaningful human control. The proposed contribution is a unified transformation-level evaluative object that combines actor indexing, history dependence, option closure, retained competence, intervention, repair, reconstructability, distribution, and non-automatic compensation. FCP is not a demand for stasis or a universal aggregate score. It is a theory for distinguishing transformations that improve present performance from those that also preserve the capacity for future correction, adaptation, and further change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"未来能力保全"（Future Capability Preservation, FCP）作为评估转型的一般性评价理论。FCP关注转型是否保留或可重构未来行动者采取行动、学习、质疑、干预、协调、拒绝、修复、重建和产生替代方案的能力条件。论文界定了FCP的范围与核心术语，阐明因果-评价机制，区分保留型、可重构型和生成型能力，并将其与韧性、适应性治理、能力方法、不可逆性、实期权、路径依赖、可持续转型及有意义的人类控制等相关理论进行定位。
AI.research_question: 如何超越现有以当前绩效、韧性、恢复力等为标准的不完整评价体系，发展一套能够评估实质性改变未来决策与行动条件的转型的通用评价理论？
AI.motivation: 现有评价标准（绩效、韧性、恢复力、适应性、合规性、总体福利）在转型会实质性改变未来决策、行动、纠正和重建条件时是不完整的，缺乏一个统一的转型层面的评价框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未来能力保全理论（FCP），整合了韧性/可转型性、适应性治理、能力方法、不可逆性与实期权推理、动态自适应路径、路径依赖、可持续转型、有意义的人类控制等理论。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析。论文通过界定范围与核心术语、阐明因果-评价机制、区分能力类型（保留/可重构/生成）、区分经验含义与规范性承诺来发展FCP理论。
AI.findings: FCP提出一个统一转型层评价对象，综合行动者索引、历史依赖、期权闭合、能力保留、干预、修复、可重构性、分配与非自动补偿。FCP并非要求停滞或追求普适总分，而是区分仅改善当前绩效的转型与同时保留未来纠错、适应和进一步变化能力的转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将此前系统层面的FCP表述扩展为一般性评价理论；统一了多个分散理论传统（韧性、能力方法、实期权、路径依赖等）中关于未来能力条件的要素；区分了保留型、可重构型与生成型能力的理论范畴；明确了经验含义、诊断要求与规范性承诺的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和决策者提供了一种评估重大转型（制度、技术、生态、知识层面的变革）时超越当前绩效的新评价标准，帮助识别哪些转型在改善当前表现的同时保留了未来纠错、适应与进一步变革的能力。

title: Situational Awareness Commerce: A Post-GUI Model for Object-Driven, Identity-Free Transactions

detail.title: Situational Awareness Commerce: A Post-GUI Model for Object-Driven, Identity-Free Transactions

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is theoretical and architectural in nature. It does not involve human subjects, personal data, behavioural tracking, experimentation, or clinical procedures. No private, sensitive, or identifiable human information was collected or processed. Accordingly, institutional review board (IRB) approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding, grants, institutional support, or commercial sponsorships were received for this study. All research, architectural development and operational infrastructure are fully self‑funded by the founding entity. No third‑party organisations contributed financially to the creation of this work.

detail.abstract: Situational Awareness Commerce describes a commercial model where objects, environments and ecosystems initiate and negotiate transactions without identity, without graphical interfaces and without websites. Originating from IoT3, Ubiquity and Smart Living research conducted in 2016 [10–14], this model replaces advertising, checkout flows and account‑based commerce with contextual triggers, autonomous objects and dissolvable interactions. Situational Awareness Commerce is the conceptual precursor to ICCA [15], providing the philosophical and technical foundations for item‑centric accountability, blind delivery and trustless commercial interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情境感知商务"（Situational Awareness Commerce）概念，描述了一种由物体、环境和生态系统发起并协商交易的商业模式，无需身份、图形界面和网站，是ICCA的概念先驱。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种无需身份、图形界面和网站，由情境感知驱动的自主交易商业模型？
AI.motivation: 传统商务模式依赖广告、结账流程和基于账户的交易，需要寻找一种由物联网和情境感知驱动的替代性商务模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 源自IoT3、Ubiquity和Smart Living研究（2016年），基于情境触发、自主对象和可消解交互等理论框架。
AI.method: 概念性研究，基于2016年开展的物联网与情境感知相关研究进行理论建构。
AI.findings: 情境感知商务用情境触发取代广告、用自主对象取代结账流程、用可消解交互取代基于账户的商业，并确立了无信任商业交互的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出情境感知商务作为ICCA的概念先驱，为以物品为中心的问责制、盲投递和无信任商业交互提供哲学与技术基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来去中心化、自主化的商业交互提供了可行的商业模式框架，对物联网商务实践具有指导意义。

title: Building and Innovating on AI Before It Is Fully Platformed: An Incomplete Technological, Industrial, and Institutional Architecture
affiliations: Northeastern University (USA)

detail.title: Building and Innovating on AI Before It Is Fully Platformed: An Incomplete Technological, Industrial, and Institutional Architecture
detail.abstract:
Generative AI has diffused rapidly, yet the decentralized investment, complementary innovation, and organizational rebuilding that a general-purpose technology requires for economy-wide transformation remain limited. This paper argues that the missing condition is not simply better models or more adoption. AI is not yet fully platformed: the technological interfaces, the industrial division of labor, and the institutional rules on which independent organizations must rely have not settled.

That distinction bears hardest on the firms that will never train a frontier model. The vast majority will buy AI rather than build it, so their prospects turn not only on what the technology can do but on whether the architecture forming around it is settled enough to build upon with confidence. Drawing on platform strategy and the history of earlier general-purpose technologies (electrification above all, where platforming unfolded over decades), the paper specifies the technological, industrial, and institutional architectures required for decentralized complementary innovation, assesses where AI stands on each, and derives four investment principles that pay off however the architecture eventually settles: learn faster than you commit, build assets that survive architectural change, invest in scarce complements rather than commodity intelligence, and build organizational capability.

AI.tldr: 本文认为生成式AI尚未完成"平台化"——技术接口、产业分工和制度规则均未定型，这限制了通用目的技术所需的去中心化投资、互补性创新和组织重塑。文章借鉴平台战略与电气化历史，明确了去中心化互补创新所需的技术、产业和制度架构，评估了AI在各维度的现状，并提出了四条在任何架构演化路径下都有效的投资原则。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI为何未能像通用目的技术那样引发经济范围的转型？AI缺少什么条件才能实现去中心化的互补性创新与广泛的投资扩散？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI扩散迅速，但围绕其展开的去中心化投资、互补性创新和组织重建仍然有限。现有讨论聚焦于模型能力或采用率，本文指出真正缺失的是AI"平台化"——即技术、产业和制度架构尚未定型，使得独立组织难以放心地在其上进行补充性投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台战略理论；通用目的技术（GPT）理论；电气化作为历史类比的历史分析框架。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文：结合平台战略文献与通用目的技术史（尤其是电气化的长期平台化过程），对AI的技术架构、产业架构和制度架构进行规范性分析评估，并推导投资原则。
AI.findings: AI尚未完全"平台化"，技术接口、产业分工与制度规则均未定型；该问题对不自研大模型、选择购买AI的绝大多数企业影响最为深远；据分析可提炼出四条跨情景稳健的投资原则：学习快于承诺、投资于能穿越架构变迁的资产、投资稀缺互补品而非商品化智能、建设组织能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平台战略与GPT理论整合至AI情境，提出"AI尚未平台化"是制约经济范围转型的关键缺失条件，并系统界定去中心化互补创新所需的三种架构（技术、产业、制度），拓展了通用目的技术扩散与平台化过程的理论界面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为绝大多数将通过购买而非自建方式获取AI的企业提供了面向架构不确定性的四条具体投资原则，帮助其在AI架构未定型阶段做出稳健的战略决策。

title: ZPID: A Zero-Knowledge Proofed Identity Attestation Framework for Deepfake-Resilient eKYC in Financial and Digital Services Rethinking Digital Identity Trust in the Age of Generative AI

detail.title: ZPID: A Zero-Knowledge Proofed Identity Attestation Framework for Deepfake-Resilient eKYC in Financial and Digital Services Rethinking Digital Identity Trust in the Age of Generative AI
detail.abstract: Current electronic Know Your Customer (eKYC) frameworks rely on three converging pillars, biometric matching, document verification, and liveness detection, all of which authenticate what an individual appears to be rather than what they cryptographically are. The emergence of generative adversarial network (GAN)-and diffusion-model-based deepfake technology has systematically compromised each pillar, with deepfake-enabled fraud losses projected to exceed USD 40 billion by 2027 (FS-ISAC, 2024) and deepfake attempts against identity verification systems growing by over 2,000% in three years. This paper introduces the Zero-Knowledge Proofed Identity Attestation (ZPID) framework, a novel, four-layer architecture that fundamentally decouples digital identity trust from visual or biometric appearance. ZPID anchors identity to a device-bound cryptographic root of trust, implements continuous behavioral entropy scoring via a Behavioral Entropy Engine (BEE), leverages ZK-SNARKs for selective attribute disclosure without exposing underlying personal data, and employs real-time randomized challenge-response mechanisms to defeat injection and replay attacks. The framework is grounded in W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs), Verifiable Credentials (VCs), FIDO2/WebAuthn standards, and post-quantum cryptographic primitives aligned with NIST PQC finalized standards. We argue that deepfake-resilient identity cannot be achieved by improving detection but only by making visual input architecturally irrelevant to identity trust. This work extends the author's prior research on deepfake impacts in financial markets (Shamo, 2024a) and post-quantum cryptographic standards harmonization (Shamo, 2024b) into the identity verification domain, proposing a unified framework suitable for regulatory alignment with FATF AML/KYC guidelines, GDPR, the EU eIDAS 2.0 regulation, and Ghana's Data Protection Act.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZPID框架，通过四层架构（设备绑定密码学信任根、行为熵引擎、ZK-SNARK选择性披露、随机挑战-响应机制）将数字身份信任与视觉/生物特征解耦，以抵御深度伪造攻击，取代传统的eKYC三支柱体系。
AI.research_question: 如何在深度伪造技术系统性攻破传统eKYC三支柱（生物识别匹配、文件验证、活体检测）的背景下，构建一种从根本上不依赖视觉或生物外观的数字身份信任框架？
AI.motivation: GAN和扩散模型驱动的深度伪造技术已系统性攻破传统eKYC体系的所有支柱，深度伪造欺诈损失预计到2027年超过400亿美元，针对身份验证系统的深度伪造攻击在三年内增长超过2000%，表明改进检测方法已不足以应对威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于W3C去中心化标识符（DIDs）、可验证凭证（VCs）、FIDO2/WebAuthn标准、零知识证明（ZK-SNARKs）以及符合NIST后量子密码标准的密码学原语。
AI.method: 提出四层架构框架：(1)设备绑定密码学信任根；(2)行为熵引擎（BEE）进行连续行为熵评分；(3)ZK-SNARKs实现选择性属性披露；(4)实时随机挑战-响应机制防御注入和重放攻击。
AI.findings: 深度伪造韧性身份无法通过改进检测实现，只能通过使视觉输入在架构层面与身份信任无关来实现；ZPID框架提供了一条与FATF AML/KYC指南、GDPR、欧盟eIDAS 2.0法规及加纳数据保护法相一致的统一身份验证路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"视觉输入架构性无关性"的范式转变，将身份信任从"看起来是谁"（appearance-based）转向"密码学上是谁"（cryptographic-based），拓展了去中心化身份和零知识证明在防深度伪造领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可直接与现行国际监管框架（FATF、GDPR、eIDAS 2.0、加纳数据保护法）对齐的实施框架，为金融机构和监管机构应对深度伪造身份欺诈提供了超越检测范式的系统性解决方案。

title: Forensic Accounting Institutionalization Gap and Tax-fraud Detection in Bangladesh: Evidence from Regulatory and Revenue Administration Systems

detail.title: Forensic Accounting Institutionalization Gap and Tax-fraud Detection in Bangladesh: Evidence from Regulatory and Revenue Administration Systems
detail.abstract:
Purpose: This article aims to explore how the forensic accounting's under-institutionalization thus restricts the capacity to detect fraud cases in organizations in Bangladesh and to suggest a theory and policy for its institutionalization. 

Design/methodology/approach: This research uses a structured secondary literature content analysis in accordance with a doctrinal legal approach, using doctrinal sources published from 1999 until 2026. Themes for analysis are limiting the scope of an audit, forensic competencies, institutional distanciation, ERP analytics, sectoral fraud risk, regulatory fragmentation, and policy adoption. Sources: peer-reviewed articles, official statutes, regulatory instruments, official reports and professional standards. 

Findings: Bangladesh has a formal system of accountability in company law, financial reporting oversight, securities law, anti-corruption law, and anti-money laundering reporting, of which 17,345 suspicious reports were received by BFIU in FY 2023-24. However, in cases of concealment, collusion, management override, TBML and/or digital complexity fraud, formal compliance is not sufficient for substantive forensic detection. This study introduces the Forensic Accounting Institutionalization Gap Theory (FAIGT) to examine the visual compliance of forensic accounting with governance requirements against the functional gaps in forensic competence, authority of the audit committee, protocols of data analytics, and the evidence system and coordination with regulatory bodies. 

Originality/value: This is one of the earliest additions to the theory of forensic accounting institutionalization and adoption in Bangladesh. By connecting BSEC, Bangladesh Bank, FRC, BFIU, ACC, ICAB and ICMAB, FAIGT sets up a structured forensic bridge which includes regulatory triggers, authority of the audit committee, professional training, continuity of forensic analytics, evidence protocols and inter-agency coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨孟加拉国法务会计机构化不足如何限制组织欺诈检测能力，提出了法务会计机构化差距理论（FAIGT），并基于1999-2026年的二手文献分析，构建了连接多个监管机构的法务桥梁框架。
AI.research_question: 法务会计的制度化不足如何限制孟加拉国组织欺诈案件检测能力？如何建立法务会计制度化的理论与实践框架？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国虽然已有正式的公司治理与监管体系（公司法、证券法、反腐败法、反洗钱报告等），但在隐匿、串通、管理层凌驾、贸易洗钱和数字复杂性欺诈等案件中，正式合规并不足以实现实质性的法务检测，需要探索法务会计制度化的路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法务会计机构化差距理论（FAIGT），并采用教义法学方法（doctrinal legal approach）结合结构化二手文献内容分析。
AI.method: 采用结构化二手文献内容分析法，结合教义法学方法，分析1999年至2026年来源的教义性文献，包括同行评审文章、官方法规、监管文件、官方报告和专业标准。分析主题涵盖审计范围限制、法务能力、机构距离、ERP分析、部门欺诈风险、监管碎片化和政策采纳。
AI.findings: 孟加拉国建立了正式责任体系，BFIU在2023-24财年收到17,345份可疑报告，但在隐匿、串通、管理层凌驾、贸易洗钱和数字复杂性欺诈案件中，正式合规不足以实现实质性法务检测。研究提出FAIGT理论以考察法务会计与治理要求的视觉合规与法务能力、审计委员会权威、数据分析协议、证据系统及监管协调方面的功能性差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究是孟加拉国法务会计制度化与采纳理论的早期贡献之一，通过连接BSEC、孟加拉国银行、FRC、BFIU、ACC、ICAB和ICMAB等机构，建立了一套结构化的法务桥梁框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 所提出的FAIGT和法务桥梁框架包含监管触发器、审计委员会权威、专业培训、法务分析连续性、证据协议和跨机构协调等具体实践要素，可为孟加拉国及类似发展中国家的政策制定和欺诈检测实践提供指导。

title: The Institutional Conditions of Governance in Ecosystems

detail.title: The Institutional Conditions of Governance in Ecosystems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of QERA, an independent consultancy working on AI and quantum governance, and conducted this work as an independent researcher. This paper is conceptual and was undertaken independently of any client engagement. No client or other organization had any role in its conception, analysis, or reporting, and no party reviewed or approved the manuscript before submission. The views expressed are the author's own. The author is aware of no other personal or financial relationship that could be perceived to have influenced this work.

detail.abstract: Much contemporary economic and social activity is organized in ecosystem form, an arrangement that reorganizes the conditions on which the governance of conduct has long depended. This paper identifies the institutional conditions under which responsibility has functioned as a mechanism of governance, and asks what governance is required where those conditions no longer hold. Responsibility has governed prospectively, because the expectation of a later reckoning gives an agent a reason to act otherwise before the harm occurs. That function rests on conditions which ordinary institutional settings supplied as a matter of course: a persisting bearer, a standard fixed in advance, a traceable path from harm to party, the convergence of control, benefit, and answerability upon one party, and an authority whose determinations bind across the field. The analysis advances no revision to the concept of responsibility; it identifies the conditions on which the practice has depended. Fields organized around a shared infrastructure withdraw those conditions. Control, benefit, and the authority to set the rules of participation gather at a nodal position; the obligations attaching to the activity are configured outward; and the division of participants into providers and recipients does not settle. Two effects follow together from that arrangement: responsibility is distributed without settling on a canonical point of imputation, and the responsibility relation itself is fragmented, its control, causal contribution, benefit, and answerability coming to rest with different parties. The dispersal so produced cannot be relied upon to be gathered back, the two requirements for re-aggregation being withheld as a standing feature of such fields, and reaggregation would not restore the anticipatory function even where it succeeds. Governance in an ecosystem therefore cannot be founded on the allocation of responsibility. It must be established in advance, and hold independently of whether responsibility is allocated at all, supplying three functions that responsibility once supplied together: the constitution of a protective boundary, its maintenance over time, and the perception of its erosion. The account offered here supplies a framework for analysing the institutional conditions on which mechanisms of governance de

AI.tldr: 本文分析生态系统（ecosystem）这一新型组织形态如何削弱了责任（responsibility）作为治理机制所依赖的制度条件。作者指出，责任治理依赖持续性承担者、预先设定的标准、可追溯的因果路径、控制/利益/可归责的统一，以及具约束力的权威等条件；而生态系统围绕共享基础设施组织，导致控制权集中于节点、义务向外配置、参与者身份不固定，使责任分散且关系碎片化，无法重新聚合。因此生态系统的治理不能建立在责任分配之上，而必须预先建立并独立于责任分配，提供保护边界、边界维护和边界侵蚀感知三大功能。
AI.research_question: 当生态系统这一组织形式使传统责任治理所依赖的制度条件不再成立时，需要何种治理机制来替代责任这一治理机制？
AI.motivation: 当代大量经济和社会活动以生态系统形式组织，这种安排重组了长期依赖的治理条件，责任作为治理机制的功能基础被削弱或瓦解，亟需识别新的治理基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 责任作为前瞻性（prospective）治理机制的理论，以及制度条件论——责任治理依赖持续性主体、预先固定的标准、可追溯的因果路径、控制-利益-可归责的统一、权威约束等制度条件。
AI.method: 概念分析与制度条件识别（理论性论文），通过解析责任治理的运作条件及其在生态系统中的失效机制，提出替代性治理框架。
AI.findings: 生态系统导致责任分散且无法重新聚合：控制、因果贡献、利益与可归责分散于不同主体；重新聚合的两个条件被系统性地 withheld，即使聚合成功也无法恢复责任的前瞻性功能。因此生态系统治理必须在责任分配之外预先建立，提供保护边界、边界维护和边界侵蚀感知三种功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 不修改责任概念本身，而是识别出责任治理实践所依赖的制度条件，揭示了生态系统这一组织形式对这些条件的系统性质疑，提出了治理机制的替代性功能框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生态系统（如平台经济、共享基础设施等）的治理实践提供了分析框架，说明为何不能依赖事后的责任追究，而需要预先设计保护性边界及其维护机制。

title: Management Information Systems for Strategic Decision-making in SMEs
affiliations: Lamar University

detail.title: Management Information Systems for Strategic Decision-making in SMEs
detail.abstract: Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) increasingly rely on Management Information Systems (MIS) to enhance strategic responsiveness and maintain competitiveness in dynamic business environments. Despite growing investments in digital technologies, limited research has examined how Management Information Systems Quality (MISQ) influences Strategic Decision Agility (SDA), particularly under varying organizational cultures and resource conditions. This study investigates the relationship between MISQ and SDA while examining the moderating role of Data-Driven Culture (DDC) and the influence of Resource Constraints (RC). Grounded in the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework and the Resource-Based View (RBV), the study adopts a quantitative approach using a cross-sectional survey design and proposes the application of Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) to evaluate the hypothesized relationships. The findings indicate that higher MISQ significantly enhances strategic decision agility by providing accurate, timely, and reliable information. A strong data-driven culture further strengthens this relationship, whereas financial, technological, and human resource constraints hinder organizational responsiveness. The study contributes to the MIS literature by offering an integrated TOE-RBV perspective and provides practical guidance for SME managers seeking to improve decision-making effectiveness, organizational agility, and long-term competitiveness through strategic information system investments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中小企业中管理信息系统质量（MISQ）如何影响战略决策敏捷性（SDA），并考察了数据驱动文化（DDC）的调节作用和资源约束（RC）的阻碍作用。基于TOE框架和资源基础观，采用PLS-SEM定量分析，发现高质量的MIS显著提升战略决策敏捷性，数据驱动文化强化该关系，而资源约束则削弱组织响应能力。
AI.research_question: 管理信息系统质量（MISQ）如何影响中小企业的战略决策敏捷性（SDA）？数据驱动文化（DDC）和资源约束（RC）在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 尽管中小企业在数字技术上投资不断增加，但有限的研究考察了MISQ对SDA的影响，特别是在不同组织文化和资源条件下。需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架；资源基础观（Resource-Based View, RBV）
AI.method: 定量研究方法，采用横截面调查设计，应用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）评估假设关系。
AI.findings: 较高的MISQ通过提供准确、及时和可靠的信息显著提升战略决策敏捷性；强大的数据驱动文化强化了这一关系；而财务、技术和人力资源约束阻碍组织响应能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过整合TOE-RBV视角，为MIS文献提供了理论贡献，扩展了对MISQ与SDA关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业管理者提供实践指导，帮助他们通过战略性信息系统投资改善决策有效性、组织敏捷性和长期竞争力。

title: Identifying Gaps and Future Research Agenda: Key Success Factors of Digital Transformation Adoption

detail.title: Identifying Gaps and Future Research Agenda: Key Success Factors of Digital Transformation Adoption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Based on my understanding, this article has no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The content of this article does not necessitate ethical approval or consent to participate, with supporting documentation.
declarations.funderStatement: This article has not been funded by any organizations or agencies. This independence ensures that the research is conducted objectively and without external influence.

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to advance knowledge for managers, policymakers, and researchers regarding the important key factors of successful Digital Transformation (DT) adoption, which can shed light on research gaps and help form a research agenda. A systematic literature review was conducted to analyse 26 peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2020 and 2025 from the Scopus, Emerald, Insight, Google Scholar, and ProQuest databases, following the PRISMA guidelines. Four DT adoption models, such as Diffusion of Innovation (DOI), Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), Task-Technology Fit (TTF), and Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), have been analysed to understand why people embrace DT either positively or negatively. According to the literature, the success factors for adopting DT have been identified. In addition, it is found that using only one DT adoption model does not ensure success. It is advisable to use an integrated multi-model or multiple frameworks for the theoretical adoption of DT. Using multiple frameworks makes DT adoption easier to understand. The Input-Process-Output (IPO) schema allows consolidating the gaps in the present state and setting out the research agenda. The IPO schema can be considered a helpful tool for identifying research gaps and setting the research agenda, as well as for planning, decision-making, and policymaking.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述（PRISMA指南），分析了2020-2025年间26篇同行评审期刊文章，探讨数字化转型（DT）采纳的关键成功因素。研究发现，单一采纳模型（如DOI、TAM、TTF、TPB）不能确保成功，建议采用整合多模型或多框架方法。同时，IPO（输入-过程-输出）框架被证明是识别研究空白和制定研究议程的有效工具。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型（DT）成功采纳的关键因素是什么？如何通过理论模型来理解人们为何积极或消极地接受数字化转型？
AI.motivation: 为管理者、政策制定者和研究者提供关于数字化转型成功采纳的关键因素知识，揭示研究空白并帮助形成研究议程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多个数字化转型采纳模型：创新扩散理论（DOI）、技术接受模型（TAM）、任务-技术匹配模型（TTF）、计划行为理论（TPB），以及输入-过程-输出（IPO）框架。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，遵循PRISMA指南，从Scopus、Emerald、Insight、Google Scholar和ProQuest数据库检索2020-2025年间发表的26篇同行评审期刊文章。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出数字化转型采纳的成功因素；2. 仅使用单一DT采纳模型不能确保成功；3. 应采用整合的多模型或多框架进行理论采纳；4. IPO框架有助于整合现有空白并制定研究议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出单一采纳模型不足以解释数字化转型的复杂性，倡导整合多模型的理论框架，并将IPO框架引入作为识别研究空白和设置研究议程的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者、政策制定者和研究者提供数字化转型成功采纳的关键因素清单，以及辅助规划、决策和政策制定的实用工具（IPO框架）。

title: Why AIs (Might) Obey the Law
affiliations: and Hebrew University of Jerusalem

detail.title: Why AIs (Might) Obey the Law
detail.abstract: AI models are no longer confined to producing content and increasingly operate as agents that take actions on behalf of users. A growing body of work empirically tests whether AI models when acting as agents comply with or violate applicable law, including corporate law, tort law, labor law, property law, and contracts. In this paper, we explore a related question: examining why AI models might obey the law. To this end, we draw on and extend the methods for measuring legal compliance pioneered in Tom Tyler’s seminal work, Why People Obey the Law (1990, 2006). Across three studies, we adapt Tyler’s survey methodology—which was originally devised to study the factors explaining human subjects’ compliance with law—to nine AI models. We elicit the AI models’ reported legal compliance alongside the four factors that Tyler proposed to explain compliance: deterrence, morality, peer disapproval, and obligation to obey the law. In Study 1, we find that, when situated as human respondents, AI models report largely homogeneous attitudes toward legal compliance that are broadly comparable to the average human respondent in Tyler’s studies, with one exception: obligation to obey the law diverges sharply across different AI models. In Study 2, we find that demographic conditioning—situating AI models with a particular background (e.g., race, gender)—substantially alters their attitudes toward law, often exaggerating associations Tyler observed in humans and sometimes reproducing stereotyped patterns. In Study 3, we investigate why AI models might themselves obey the law when performing tasks that AI models can undertake in practice. We find that AI models uniformly report near-complete compliance with law, but their attitudes toward law vary substantially: some AI models express a strong sense of obligation to comply with law, while others express a more neutral attitude toward law. Taken together, our methods and results lay the foundation for interrogating the legal compliance of contemporary AI models, as well as shaping the development of future models and their relationship to law.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴Tyler的经典法律遵从研究方法，跨三项研究对九种AI模型进行调查，探究AI模型为何会遵守法律。研究发现AI模型在合法合规态度上与人类平均水平相当，但“遵守法律的义务感”在模型间差异显著；人口统计学条件设定会显著改变AI模型的法律态度；AI模型在执行实际任务时普遍报告近乎完全的法律遵从，但对法律的态度差异较大。
AI.research_question: AI模型作为代理行动时为何可能遵守法律？哪些因素（威慑、道德、同伴 disapproval、遵守法律的义务感）能解释AI模型的法律遵从行为？
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型从内容生成转向代理行动（如代表用户采取行动），其法律遵从成为一个日益重要的问题。已有研究主要检验AI模型是否遵守法律，但很少探究AI模型为何遵守法律。本文借鉴Tyler的经典理论框架，系统探究AI模型法律遵从背后的心理和机制因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tyler的程序正义理论（Why People Obey the Law, 1990, 2006），提出法律遵从的四个解释因素：威慑（deterrence）、道德（morality）、同伴 disapproval（peer disapproval）、遵守法律的义务感（obligation to obey the law）。
AI.method: 将Tyler的问卷调查方法适配到九种AI模型，开展三项研究：（1）将AI模型设定为人类受访者，测量其法律遵从态度及四个解释因素；（2）通过人口统计学条件设定（种族、性别等）改变AI模型的背景，检验态度变化；（3）考察AI模型在执行实际任务时对法律遵从的自我报告及其态度差异。
AI.findings: （1）AI模型在设定为人类受访者时，法律遵从态度总体与人类平均水平相当且高度同质，但“遵守法律的义务感”在不同模型间差异显著；（2）人口统计学条件设定会实质改变AI模型的法律态度，有时放大Tyler在人类中观察到的关联，有时复制刻板印象模式；（3）AI模型在执行实际任务时普遍报告近乎完全的法律遵从，但对法律的态度——从强烈的义务感到中性态度——各有不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Tyler的法律遵从理论框架扩展到AI模型领域，为理解AI代理的法律遵从机制提供了理论基础；揭示了AI模型在法律遵从态度上的同质性与异质性并存的特征，拓展了法律遵从研究的对象范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估和监督AI代理的法律遵从提供了方法论基础；为塑造未来AI模型与法律的关系、指导AI模型开发中法律合规设计提供了实证依据。
