title: Governance Gaps in Human-Directed AI Development: Empirical Evidence, Theoretical Foundations, and the Human-AI Co-Authorship Protocol (HAICA)

detail.title: Governance Gaps in Human-Directed AI Development: Empirical Evidence, Theoretical Foundations, and the Human-AI Co-Authorship Protocol (HAICA)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently by the author under the XWHYZ/WHYLD Research Division, a self-funded independent research operation. No grants, institutional funding, corporate sponsorship, or third-party financial support of any kind was received or sought in connection with this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. The author is the sole developer of HAICA and the Century Framework (XWHYZ/WHYLD, 2026). No advisory relationships, equity holdings, or institutional affiliations exist that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable. This paper presents a systematic review of publicly available security research data and a theoretical governance framework. No human participants, patient data, clinical studies, personal data collection, surveys, or primary data collection involving people was conducted. No ethics board review is required for this research type.

detail.abstract: The rapid normalization of human-directed AI development — the practice of producing functional software artifacts through natural language instruction of AI systems — has created a structural governance gap that existing legal, security, and accountability frameworks are not equipped to address. This paper identifies, characterizes, and quantifies that gap through a systematic review of empirical evidence, and proposes a theoretically grounded governance architecture as the primary research output. Drawing on published security research across 5,600 publicly accessible AI-assisted applications, vulnerability analysis of outputs from 100+ large language models (Veracode, 2025), and CVE attribution data (Cloud Security Alliance, 2026), this paper establishes that: (1) 45% of AI-generated code introduces OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities; (2) AI-assisted commits expose credentials at 2.1× the rate of humanauthored commits; (3) CVEs attributable to AI-generated code increased 483% between January and March 2026; and (4) a novel, previously uncharacterized vulnerability class — packaging configuration exposure — is not addressed by any existing static analysis tooling. The paper argues that these failures share a single structural cause: existing governance frameworks assume the human author and the code author are the same entity, an assumption that fails when human cognitive intent is translated into executable systems through an AI-mediated execution channel. To address this gap, the paper introduces three original theoretical constructs — the cognitive instrument, prompt lineage as an authorship evidence category, and packaging configuration as a formal vulnerability class — and presents the Human-AI Co-Authorship Protocol (HAICA) as an operational governance architecture derived from these constructs. HAICA has been independently assessed at a composite score of 9.5/10 across nine governance dimensions and is published under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20509820.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并量化了AI辅助软件开发中存在的结构性治理鸿沟——现有法律、安全和问责框架假定人类作者与代码作者为同一实体，但这一假设在AI中介执行通道下失效。论文基于系统性实证证据，提出三个理论构念并构建了Human-AI Co-Authorship Protocol (HAICA)作为操作性治理架构。
AI.research_question: AI辅助开发（通过自然语言指令生产软件制品）所产生的结构性治理鸿沟是什么？如何对其特征化、量化并建立理论基础的治理架构来进行弥补？
AI.motivation: AI辅助软件开发正快速常态化，但现有法律、安全和问责框架无法应对这一新型开发模式，存在结构性治理空白。该空白源于一个根本假设的失效：治理框架假定人类作者与代码作者是同一实体，然而在AI中介执行通道下，人类认知意图转化为可执行系统时该假设不再成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出三个原创性理论构念：(1) 认知工具（cognitive instrument）——界定人类通过AI进行编码时的认知客体地位；(2) 提示词谱系（prompt lineage）——作为新的作者身份证据类别；(3) 打包配置暴露（packaging configuration exposure）——作为正式漏洞类别。并以此构建了Human-AI Co-Authorship Protocol (HAICA)治理架构。
AI.method: 系统综述实证证据：对5,600个公开可访问的AI辅助应用程序进行安全研究分析；对100+个大型语言模型输出进行漏洞分析（基于Veracode 2025数据）；分析CVE归因数据（基于Cloud Security Alliance 2026数据）。
AI.findings: (1) 45%的AI生成代码引入OWASP Top 10漏洞；(2) AI辅助提交暴露凭据的比率是人类编写提交的2.1倍；(3) 归因于AI生成代码的CVE在2026年1月至3月间增长了483%；(4) 发现一种全新且此前未被特征化的漏洞类别——打包配置暴露——现有静态分析工具均无法检测。HAICA协议在九个治理维度上获得9.5/10的综合评分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出三个原创理论构念（认知工具、提示词谱系作为作者身份证据类别、打包配置作为正式漏洞类别），填补了AI中介开发模式下治理理论框架的空白，挑战了传统的作者-代码同一性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的治理架构HAICA协议（已独立评估为9.5/10），为AI辅助开发的安全治理、问责机制和漏洞分类提供实践指南；识别新漏洞类别为安全工具和标准制定提供方向。

title: The Problems with “Sensitive Data” In Eu Law – And Whether, Or When, Location Data Should Be Considered to Constitute Such Data
affiliations: Oxford Martin School - Global Cyber Capacity Centre

detail.title: The Problems with “Sensitive Data” In Eu Law – And Whether, Or When, Location Data Should Be Considered to Constitute Such Data

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable

detail.abstract:
The question of whether, and if so when and how, some personal data should be treated more strictly than other personal data has been a vexed one since the drafting of the earliest European data protection instruments. This short note revisits the arguments and developments in this regard, before turning to the specific issue of whether, or when and how, precise geolocation data can or should be regarded as “sensitive data” in terms of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), or otherwise strictly treated. I summarise my analyses and conclusions at the end.

The paper was written at the request of the Irish Council for Civil Liberties. However, all views expressed in it are merely the author's.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了欧洲数据保护法中关于某些个人数据应否受到更严格处理的长期争论，并专门探讨了精确地理位置数据在GDPR下是否以及如何应被视为"敏感数据"或受到严格处理的问题。作者在文末总结了其分析与结论。
AI.research_question: 精确地理位置数据在GDPR框架下是否应（以及在何种情况下、以何种方式）被视为"敏感数据"或受到更严格的处理？
AI.motivation: 自欧洲最早的数据保护文书起草以来，关于某些个人数据是否应比其他个人数据受到更严格对待的问题一直存在争议。作者受爱尔兰公民自由委员会委托撰写此文，旨在厘清精确地理位置数据在GDPR下的敏感数据地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟通用数据保护条例（GDPR）中关于敏感数据（特殊类别数据）的法律框架及欧洲数据保护立法的发展历史。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis）：回顾历史论证与发展，结合GDPR相关条款对精确地理位置数据是否构成敏感数据进行法律解释与分析。
AI.findings: 作者在文末提供了关于精确地理位置数据是否以及何时应被视为敏感数据或应受严格处理的详细分析和结论（摘要未具体展开）。
AI.theory_contributions: 对GDPR敏感数据范畴的理解提供了新的分析视角，特别是将精确地理位置数据纳入敏感数据处理讨论的理论论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构及公民权利组织（如爱尔兰公民自由委员会）就地理位置数据的保护等级提供法律分析参考；该文系受爱尔兰公民自由委员会委托撰写，具有直接的实践政策意义。

title: A Review on: Impact of Artificial Intelligence in Daily Life
affiliations: Vivekananda Global University, Jaipur

detail.title: A Review on: Impact of Artificial Intelligence in Daily Life

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or clinical data. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study did not involve a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has moved from specialized laboratories into ordinary routines. Search engines rank information, navigation applications estimate routes, streaming platforms recommend content, smartphones improve photographs, banks screen transactions, and generative AI systems assist with writing, coding and learning. This review examines the impact of AI in daily life with attention to education, healthcare, communication, transportation, finance, entertainment, shopping, workplaces and smart homes. It also discusses risks such as privacy loss, biased automated decisions, misinformation, over-dependence and changes in employment. The paper uses a descriptive review methodology based on published research and reports from established institutions. The evidence suggests that AI can improve convenience, accessibility, speed and personalization, but its benefits depend on human oversight, responsible data practices and AI literacy. The central conclusion is that AI should be treated as a supporting technology rather than an unquestioned replacement for human judgement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过描述性综述方法，系统考察了人工智能在日常生活中的影响，覆盖教育、医疗、通信、交通、金融、娱乐、购物、工作场所和智能家居等领域，同时讨论了隐私泄露、算法偏见、虚假信息、过度依赖和就业变化等风险，最终结论是AI应被视为辅助技术而非人类判断的替代品。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在日常生活中的影响是什么？其潜在风险有哪些？AI应被如何定位（替代vs辅助）？
AI.motivation: AI已从专业实验室进入日常生活的方方面面，但缺乏对其全面影响的系统性审视，需要综合评估其收益与风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文为描述性综述，未明确提出特定的理论框架，主要基于已有研究和权威机构报告进行归纳与综合。
AI.method: 描述性综述方法（descriptive review methodology），基于已发表的研究和权威机构的报告进行文献综合与分析。
AI.findings: AI在便利性、可及性、速度和个性化方面能带来显著改善，但其收益依赖于人类监督、负责任的数据实践和AI素养；AI的风险包括隐私泄露、自动化决策偏见、虚假信息、过度依赖和就业变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个跨领域的综合性视角，系统梳理了AI在日常生活中的多维影响，并提炼出"AI作为辅助技术而非替代品"的核心定位框架，为后续研究提供了整合性的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和教育工作者提供了关于AI应用的风险认知清单，强调了人类监督、数据治理和AI素养培养对于AI有效落地的重要性。

title: Why Ethical Frameworks must be Selected, not Averaged

detail.title: Why Ethical Frameworks must be Selected, not Averaged

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of Almma.AI. This paper is conceptual and presents no empirical results; the views expressed are the author's own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Most AI systems implicitly mix ethical frameworks-consequentialism, deontology, virtue ethics-producing behavior that is inconsistent, opaque, and structurally unevaluable. This paper argues that ethical frameworks are non-additive: blending them does not produce a more ethical system; it produces an unauditable one. Non-additivity, as used here, refers to evaluability and auditability under governance conditions-not to the theoretical impossibility of constructing hybrid ethical theories. The core claim, grounded in assessment theory and moral philosophy, is that framework selection is not a philosophical luxury but an evaluability condition. A moral output cannot be audited, corrected, or trusted unless the framework that produced it was declared in advance. Treating ethics as a configurable governance layer-explicitly selected for each deployment context-improves transparency, enables meaningful oversight, and transforms ethics from a residual constraint into a designable system component.

AI.tldr: 本文论证AI系统中的伦理框架（后果主义、道义论、美德伦理）不可简单叠加混合。混合伦理框架不会产生更道德的AI系统，反而会产生不可审计、不可评估、不透明的系统。文章核心主张是：伦理框架的选择应被视为可配置的治理层，在部署前明确声明，从而将伦理从残余约束转变为可设计的系统组件。
AI.research_question: AI系统中伦理框架的非可加性如何影响系统的可评估性与可审计性？伦理框架的预先声明为何是AI系统治理的必要条件？
AI.motivation: 当前大多数AI系统隐式混合了多种伦理框架（后果主义、道义论、美德伦理），导致行为不一致、不透明且在结构上无法评估。作者认为这个问题没有被充分认识——伦理框架混合不是理论问题，而是治理与审计的结构性障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于评估理论（assessment theory）与道德哲学（moral philosophy），提出伦理框架的"非可加性"概念——指在治理条件下的可评估性与可审计性，而非构建混合伦理理论的理论不可能性。
AI.method: 概念分析与规范性论证。通过评估理论和道德哲学的理论框架，对AI系统伦理框架混合问题进行哲学分析，提出以"可配置治理层"为核心的设计主张。
AI.findings: (1) 伦理框架混合产生不可审计的AI系统；(2) 框架选择不是哲学奢侈品，而是可评估性条件；(3) 道德输出只有在框架预先声明的前提下才能被审计、纠正或信任；(4) 将伦理作为针对每个部署情境显式选择的可配置治理层，能改善透明度并实现有意义的监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"伦理框架非可加性"概念，将伦理框架选择从哲学讨论重新定位为治理与评估的结构性条件，为AI伦理治理提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计提供实践指导：伦理应作为可配置的治理层在每个部署情境中显式预先选择，从而将伦理从残余约束转变为可设计的系统组件，提升系统的透明性、可审计性和可监督性。

title: One Drug, Many Prices: A Proposal to Reform US Healthcare Pricing
affiliations: Montclair State University

detail.title: One Drug, Many Prices: A Proposal to Reform US Healthcare Pricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: This note proposes a reform of US healthcare pricing that targets cost containment. It comprises three components: consolidate all federal purchasing into a single negotiating Bloc, make each provider’s negotiated price binding on every payer as a condition of market access, and publish every contracted price in a central lookup system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一项美国医疗保健定价改革方案，旨在控制成本。改革包含三个组成部分：将联邦采购整合为单一谈判集团、使提供者的议定价格对所有支付方具有约束力（作为市场准入条件）、以及在中央查询系统中公布所有合同价格。
AI.research_question: 如何通过医疗保健定价改革来实现美国医疗成本控制？
AI.motivation: 美国医疗费用持续高企，需要通过结构性定价改革来实现成本控制目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 谈判力量理论（集中采购形成买方垄断力量）、价格透明理论（信息不对称的缓解）、市场准入规制理论。
AI.method: 政策方案设计/规范性分析，提出三项具体的制度改革建议。
AI.findings: 通过三项改革措施的协同作用——集中谈判、价格约束力扩展和价格透明化——可以实现更有效的医疗成本控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗定价改革提供了一个整合性的制度设计方案，将买方议价能力、价格外部性约束与信息公开机制结合起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国医疗政策制定者提供了一套具体可操作的三步式定价改革方案，涵盖采购整合、市场准入条件和透明化机制。

title: How to Shrink a Central Bank: The Optimal Pace of Quantitative Tightening
affiliations: University of Oxford, Saïd Business School and University of Oxford, Saïd Business School

detail.title: How to Shrink a Central Bank: The Optimal Pace of Quantitative Tightening
detail.abstract: How quickly should a central bank shrink its balance sheet after quantitative easing? In our model, the supply of reserves affects financial conditions even when the administered interest rate is unchanged. Reserve reduction poses a timing tradeoff: moving quickly can strain payments and financial intermediation, while moving slowly extends the period over which declining reserves tighten financial conditions. Private spending responds to expected future financial conditions, so the announced path of quantitative tightening affects demand from the outset. We characterize both the reserve path and its completion date. Without an output-stabilization motive, the optimal path starts quickly and tapers to zero. Stabilization can instead bring completion forward when the cost of prolonged reserve scarcity is large, or slow the transition when short-run payment strains dominate. In a counterfactual U.S. exercise, output stabilization shortens the benchmark transition from 14.00 to 12.21 quarters. Stronger payment-flow effects produce a longer, smoother path. The dollar magnitudes are illustrative, but the timing tradeoff is general: the pace of quantitative tightening depends on the cost of moving quickly and the cost of taking too long.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个央行量化紧缩（QT）最优路径的理论模型，探讨准备金供给如何影响金融条件，以及央行应如何权衡快速与缓慢缩减资产负债表的利弊。研究发现，在没有产出稳定目标时，最优路径是"先快后慢"的锥形路径；加入产出稳定目标后，会依据支付压力与准备金稀缺成本的大小，决定是提前还是推迟完成紧缩。美国反事实分析显示，产出稳定可将基准过渡期从14.00个季度缩短至12.21个季度。
AI.research_question: 中央银行在量化宽松之后应多快地缩减其资产负债表？最优的量化紧缩路径及其完成时间是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多关注量化宽松（QE）的效果，但对量化紧缩（QT）的最优路径缺乏系统研究。现实中央行在这一问题上面临两难：快速紧缩会冲击支付系统和金融中介，缓慢紧缩则会延长准备金稀缺对金融条件的收紧效应。一个关键事实是，即使在管理利率不变的情况下，准备金供给的变化仍会影响金融条件，这为研究QT的最优节奏提供了理论空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于准备金供给影响金融条件的理论框架，引入私人支出对预期未来金融条件的响应机制。央行面临加快紧缩（支付和金融中介压力）与放慢紧缩（准备金稀缺延长对金融条件的收紧）之间的权衡，并在有无产出稳定目标的条件下求解最优准备金路径及其完成日期。
AI.method: 构建理论最优化模型，刻画央行在支付压力成本与准备金稀缺成本之间的动态权衡；通过求解最优准备金路径与完成日期，进行模型推导与性质刻画；并结合美国数据开展反事实定量分析。
AI.findings: （1）在没有产出稳定动机时，最优准备金缩减路径是"快速启动、逐渐渐近到零"的锥形路径；（2）加入产出稳定目标后，当准备金长期稀缺成本较大时，完成时间会提前；当短期支付压力占主导时，过渡会放缓；（3）美国反事实分析表明，产出稳定可将基准过渡期从14.00个季度缩短至12.21个季度；（4）更强的支付流动效应会产生更长更平滑的路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统刻画了量化紧缩的最优路径和完成时间，揭示了"即使管理利率不变，准备金供给变化仍影响金融条件"这一关键机制，并将支付压力与准备金稀缺成本纳入统一的最优控制框架，补充了货币政策正常化领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行设计量化紧缩的时间表提供了理论指导和可操作的最优路径框架；明确指出QT的节奏取决于"快速行动的成本"与"拖延过久的成本"之间的权衡，并提供了基于美国数据的反事实参考数值，有助于央行在产出稳定和金融稳定之间做出更科学的政策决策。

title: Pareto Normalization and Tail-Elasticity Stability in Trade Counterfactuals *
affiliations: Shanhai Academy of Social Science, Shanhai Academy of Social Science

detail.title: Pareto Normalization and Tail-Elasticity Stability in Trade Counterfactuals *
detail.abstract: Many structural and sufficient-statistics trade counterfactuals transport a common trade or selection elasticity across comparison environments. This practice relies on a rarely examined stability premise: the tail geometry supporting the elasticity is not reshaped by the comparison. This note proposes a Pareto-rank diagnostic that turns this implicit premise into an observable necessary condition. The diagnostic normalizes upper-tail ranks into a Pareto coordinate and studies the inverse map back to economic units. Its key object, the local gauge elasticity a(z) = d ln q(z)/d ln z, summarizes elasticity-relevant tail geometry. For counterfactuals supported by stable tail geometry, stability of a(z) is equivalent to log-quantile parallelism on the declared tail interval. The diagnostic is one-sided: instability rejects the maintained premise, while stability is only a non-rejection and does not validate the full structural model. It provides a model-agnostic robustness screen for pre-policy stability, exposure-related tail reshaping, and comparability across counterfactuals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个帕累托秩诊断工具（Pareto-rank diagnostic），用于检验贸易反事实分析中常见的"尾部几何稳定性"前提假设。该诊断将上尾秩标准化为帕累托坐标，通过局部弹性 a(z) = d ln q(z)/d ln z 来衡量尾部几何，稳定性等价于对数分位数平行性。这是一个单侧检验：不稳定可拒绝前提，稳定仅是未拒绝而非完全验证模型。
AI.research_question: 如何将反事实分析中隐含的"尾部几何稳定性"前提转化为可观测的必要条件并加以诊断？
AI.motivation: 许多结构性贸易反事实和充分统计量反事实在跨比较环境中运输共同的贸易或选择弹性，这一做法依赖一个很少被检验的稳定性前提：支撑弹性的尾部几何不会被比较环境重塑。该前提缺乏可检验的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 帕累托秩诊断框架；局部规范弹性 a(z) = d ln q(z)/d ln z；对数分位数平行性（log-quantile parallelism）；尾部几何稳定性理论。
AI.method: 提出帕累托秩诊断方法：将上尾秩归一化为帕累托坐标，研究逆映射回经济单位；构建局部规范弹性作为反映尾部几何的关键对象；将稳定性条件转化为对数分位数平行性的等价检验。
AI.findings: 对于由稳定尾部几何支持的反事实，a(z) 的稳定性等价于在声明的尾部区间上的对数分位数平行性。诊断是单侧的：不稳定拒绝维持的前提，而稳定仅是非拒绝，不能验证完整结构模型的正确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将隐含且未检验的尾部稳定性前提转化为可操作的诊断条件，明确了稳定性与对数分位数平行性的等价关系，提供了模型无关的理论诊断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策前稳定性、暴露相关尾部重塑以及跨反事实可比性提供模型无关的稳健性筛选工具，帮助研究者识别依赖弹性跨环境运输的反事实分析中的潜在失效风险。

title: Single Peaked Productions, Network Formation and the Hierarchic Division of Labor Market

detail.title: Single Peaked Productions, Network Formation and the Hierarchic Division of Labor Market
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a network formation model to study organizational hierarchies, in which heterogeneous agents can simultaneously act as supervisors and workers under a rule of order compatibility. We introduce a separately single-peaked production function for workersupervisor pairs to form dyads, whereby an agent's productivity in either role is maximized when the other partner's type differs by an intermediate amount. The resulting networks are hierarchies with connected layers of non-assortative matching with respect to agents' types. We introduce vertical monotonicity to describe type sorting at the layer level for hierarchic networks. We find that, under supermodularity, role-priority dominance together with layerboundary type alignment guarantees the vertical monotonicity in pairwise stable networks, ensuring that adjacent types constitute the best-matched candidates both for working under upper-layer supervisors and for supervising lower-layer workers. Under efficiency, distorted type gaps within dyads, whether excessively wide or narrow, are corrected, leading to non-monotonic vertical reorganization of the hierarchy. Accordingly, we develop an inductive local-constraint search algorithm, in which neighbouring adjustments progressively correct distorted type gaps, to solve for strongly efficient networks. Finally, by embedding the model in a dynamic network formation process, we show that pairwise stable and strongly efficient networks form without and with transfers, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个网络形成模型来研究组织层级结构，其中异质性代理人可以在顺序兼容规则下同时担任监督者和工作者。引入了单独单峰的生产函数来刻画工作者-监督者配对，发现产生的网络是具有非分类匹配连接层的层级结构。通过引入垂直单调性来描述层级网络的类型排序，发现在超模性条件下，角色优先支配与层边界类型对齐共同保证了成对稳定网络中的垂直单调性。在效率条件下，扭曲的类型差距会被纠正，导致非单调的垂直重组。作者开发了一种归纳式局部约束搜索算法来求解强有效网络，并通过动态网络形成过程展示了成对稳定和强有效网络的形成。
AI.research_question: 在异质性代理人可以同时担任监督者和工作者的组织层级网络中，稳定且有效的网络结构具有何种特征？如何刻画层级间的类型排序规律？
AI.motivation: 传统的组织层级研究通常假设同质性匹配或简化的一对一监督关系，未能充分捕捉现实中代理人可同时身兼双重角色（既是下属的监督者又是上级的工作者）的复杂性，以及层级间类型匹配的非单调性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络形成模型；单独单峰生产函数；成对稳定性（pairwise stability）；强有效性（strong efficiency）；超模性（supermodularity）；垂直单调性（vertical monotonicity）
AI.method: 构建异质性代理人同时作为监督者和工作者的网络形成博弈模型，引入顺序兼容规则与单独单峰生产函数，采用成对稳定性和强效率概念进行均衡分析，并开发归纳式局部约束搜索算法求解强有效网络，最后嵌入动态网络形成过程验证结果。
AI.findings: （1）在超模性条件下，角色优先支配与层边界类型对齐共同保证成对稳定网络的垂直单调性，确保相邻类型构成最佳匹配候选；（2）在效率条件下，过宽或过窄的扭曲类型差距会被纠正，导致层级的非单调垂直重组；（3）成对稳定网络和强有效网络分别在没有转移支付和有转移支付的动态过程中形成。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将单独单峰生产函数引入网络形成模型研究组织层级，提出垂直单调性概念刻画层级层面的类型排序，揭示了层边界类型对齐在保证层级垂直排序中的核心作用，弥合了成对稳定性与效率之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计提供了理论指导：企业可通过调整层级边界和角色分配来促进有效的层级结构形成；归纳式局部约束搜索算法可为实际组织优化层级配置提供计算工具；动态网络形成结果对组织变革中转移支付机制的设计具有实践启示。

title: Exploitative or Productivity-Based Social Policy? Decomposing the Components of Disability Subminimum Wages
affiliations: University of Toronto and University of Alberta - Department of Sociology

detail.title: Exploitative or Productivity-Based Social Policy? Decomposing the Components of Disability Subminimum Wages

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used publicly available, deidentified secondary data and did not require institutional research ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research, author- ship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Many workers in the United States are paid less than the minimum wage. For certain workers, including people with disabilities, Section 14(c) of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) allows certificate-holding employers to pay workers subminimum wages to support labor market productivity. However, subminimum wages are associated with a range of factors beyond Section 14(c) certificates, and these wages are often linked to poverty. Using 2009-2019 CPS-MORG data and a series of decomposition models, we examine how different individual, organizational, and regional variables contribute to the prevalence of subminimum wages in competitive employment among hourly workers with disabilities, especially those with cognitive or independent living disabilities. Decomposition models show that varying rates were linked to work characteristics and occupational differences, far more than individual variation, highlighting the role of norms and organizations in supporting the use of subminimum wages. Throughout, we emphasize how national policies and their implementation via states and organizations differently affect outcomes for people with disabilities. The findings in this paper speak to earning subminimum wages beyond the Section 14(c) certificate system and come at a time of increased political focus on raising the minimum wage more generally.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用2009-2019年美国CPS-MORG数据和一系列分解模型，考察了个人、组织和区域变量如何影响残疾小时工（特别是认知或独立生活障碍者）在竞争性就业中获得低于最低工资（subminimum wages）的普遍程度。研究发现，工作特征和职业差异的作用远大于个体差异，凸显了规范和组织在支持低于最低工资使用中的角色，并强调国家政策经由州和组织的实施对残疾人结果产生不同影响。
AI.research_question: 哪些个人、组织和区域因素导致了残疾小时工在竞争性就业中获得低于最低工资的普遍程度？这些因素的作用如何？
AI.motivation: 低于最低工资通常与贫困相关联，且此类工资的存在不仅涉及《公平劳动标准法》第14(c)条的证书系统，还涉及更广泛的因素。当前美国提升最低工资的政治关注度上升，为理解低于最低工资的多重成因提供了重要时机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分解模型的方法框架，结合劳动市场规范、组织实践与国家/州/组织多层次政策实施理论，考察个体、组织、区域变量对低于最低工资的影响。
AI.method: 使用2009-2019年CPS-MORG数据，采用一系列分解模型（decomposition models），纳入个人、组织和区域特征进行因素分解分析。
AI.findings: 工作特征和职业差异比个体差异更能解释残疾工人获得低于最低工资的差异率，表明规范和组织的角色在支持低于最低工资的使用方面更为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 超越第14(c)条证书系统的框架，从多层次（国家政策、州实施、组织实践）视角理解低于最低工资的产生机制，强调了组织规范在低收入决定中的理论作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，说明提升最低工资政策需要关注组织层面的障碍与规范，以及州级政策实施差异对残疾人就业收入的影响，具有现实政策参考价值。

title: Brexit Uncertainty and Firm Markup: Evidence from German Manufacturing
affiliations: Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg

detail.title: Brexit Uncertainty and Firm Markup: Evidence from German Manufacturing
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Brexit uncertainty on firm markup. We borrow data from the Amtliche Firmendaten für Deutschland (AFiD) database on German manufacturing firms for the period 2014-18. We measure the markup of German firms reflecting firm profitability. Using the Brexit referendum as a quasi-natural experiment, the findings indicate that early post-referendum Brexit uncertainty reduces firm profitability, as indicated by a 1.3 % decline in overall firm markup, labor input markup by 1.5 %, and intermediate input markup by 1.3 % of treated German firms relative to the control firms. We attribute this decline to the cost pressures, as trade flows decline, which force the firms to operate at sub-optimal levels. Notably, these markup effects are primarily observed by singleproduct firms due to their limited capacity to reallocate resources, whereas noncore firms exhibit dependence on peripheral products, observing markup loss. We confirm the main results through robustness checks and discuss policy implications.

title: Factors Affecting Purchase Decision of Private Health Insurance among Malaysian Working Adults amid Rising Premiums

detail.title: Factors Affecting Purchase Decision of Private Health Insurance among Malaysian Working Adults amid Rising Premiums

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No any conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: not related

detail.abstract: This study identifies and examines the factors affecting the purchase decision of private health insurance (PHI) among Malaysian working adults in the challenging context of rising premiums. As Malaysia's dual-tier healthcare system encounters increasing pressure, understanding the determinants of PHI uptake is crucial for policymakers, providers, and consumers. This study investigates the impact of seven factors, which include Attitude, Subjective Norms, Perceived Behavioral Control, Perceived Financial Vulnerability, Health Insurance Literacy, Trust in Insurance Providers, and Perceived Effectiveness of Government Intervention on the decision to purchase PHI. A quantitative, cross-sectional survey design was employed, collecting and finalizing data from a sample of 233 Malaysian working adults. The data was analyzed with descriptive statistics, reliability analysis, Pearson's correlation, and multiple linear regression to test the research hypotheses. The regression model was statistically significant, it is accounting for 34.2% of the variance in the purchase decision. The results showed that four factors were significant positive predictors. Subjective Norms was shown to be the strongest predictor, followed by Trust in Insurance Providers, Perceived Financial Vulnerability, and Health Insurance Literacy. Conversely, Attitude and Perceived Effectiveness of Government Intervention were not significant. A key finding was that Perceived Behavioral Control had a significant negative relationship with the purchase decision, contradicting the traditional Theory of Planned Behavior. The research concludes that in a high-cost environment, the decision to acquire PHI is influenced more by fundamental trust, social pressures, and the fear of financial risk than by general attitude or self-efficacy. The findings provide insurance providers valuable insights to focus on building trust and improving customer education, and offer politicians useful information on better communication of regulatory initiatives. This study enhances the academic literature by highlighting the context-specific limitations encountered by conventional behavioral models in complex financial decision-making of Malaysian working adults in a challenging economic environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查马来西亚在职成年人在保费上涨背景下购买私人健康保险（PHI）的影响因素。通过233名受访者的横断面调查发现，主观规范、对保险供应商的信任、感知财务脆弱性和健康保险素养是显著的正向预测因素，其中主观规范最强；感知行为控制呈显著负向关系，与传统计划行为理论相悖。
AI.research_question: 在马来西亚保费上涨的挑战性背景下，哪些因素影响在职成年人购买私人健康保险的决策？
AI.motivation: 马来西亚双重医疗体系面临日益增大的压力，保费不断上涨，理解私人健康保险购买决策的决定因素对于政策制定者、保险供应商和消费者都至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior），包含态度、主观规范和感知行为控制三个核心构念，并扩展了感知财务脆弱性、健康保险素养、对保险供应商的信任以及政府干预感知有效性等额外因素。
AI.method: 采用定量横断面调查设计，收集233名马来西亚在职成年人的数据，运用描述性统计、信度分析、皮尔逊相关分析和多元线性回归检验研究假设。
AI.findings: 回归模型显著，解释了购买决策34.2%的方差。四个显著正向预测因素为：主观规范（最强）、对保险供应商的信任、感知财务脆弱性和健康保险素养。态度和政府干预感知有效性不显著。感知行为控制与购买决策呈显著负相关，与传统计划行为理论预期相悖。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究揭示了传统行为模型（如计划行为理论）在复杂金融决策情境下的局限性，强调了在高成本环境中常规行为模型的应用存在情境特异性限制，丰富了关于马来西亚在职成年人在挑战性经济环境下财务决策行为的学术文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险供应商提供关于建立信任和改善客户教育的建议；为政策制定者提供关于如何更有效地沟通监管举措的参考信息。

title: Policy Conflict Cascades in Multi-Agent Runtime Governance: A Taxonomy, Resolution Mechanism, and Empirical Evaluation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Policy Conflict Cascades in Multi-Agent Runtime Governance: A Taxonomy, Resolution Mechanism, and Empirical Evaluation
detail.abstract: Enterprise multi-agent AI systems operate under simultaneous governance policies-regulatory, organizational, and task-level-that can produce conflicting enforcement decisions at runtime. Existing frameworks resolve such conflicts locally, evaluating only the policies attached to the single acting agent; we argue this is the wrong scope, since a governance decision's real cost is frequently graph-wide rather than local. When a governance policy blocks one agent, the effect propagates through dependent agents, creating enforcement cascades that existing, per-agent-scoped frameworks neither model nor measure. Current runtime governance approaches [6, 16, 19, 20] treat enforcement as a per-agent problem, leaving inter-agent dependency effects entirely unaddressed. We introduce a taxonomy of three policy conflict cascade types-blocking, contradiction, and escalation-and propose CARM, a Cascade-Aware Resolution Mechanism that detects conflicts, estimates downstream propagation, and selects resolution strategies that we prove are the exact minimizer of a stated governance cost, not a hand-tuned rule. CARM is extended along the same system-level principle by an outcome-aware resolution selector for which we prove, and adversarially stresstest across 15,000 synthetic trials, that permanent workflow failure cannot occur, and by a lightweight, privacypreserving reach-declaration handshake that extends reach estimation across organizational boundaries, recovering 95.9% of a full-visibility oracle's escalation decisions from a single declared number. Across a controlled four-agent workflow and a large-scale sweep of synthetic topologies, cascade-aware resolution achieves the highest resolution fidelity by selectively escalating only high-reach, highseverity conflicts to human review, minimizing irreversible automated failures. Policy conflict in multi-agent systems is not a per-agent problem, and, we show, not only a singleorganization problem either-it is a systems problem.

AI.tldr: 本文针对企业多智能体AI系统中多重治理策略冲突的问题，提出级联感知的冲突解决机制（CARM）。作者认为现有框架仅基于单个智能体本地解决冲突是错误的范畴，因为治理决策的实际成本通常是全局图级别的。论文引入三类策略冲突级联类型（阻塞、矛盾、升级），提出CARM机制检测冲突、估计下游传播并选择严格最优的解决策略；并扩展了结果感知的解决选择器（通过15000次对抗压力测试证明不会发生永久工作流失败）以及跨组织边界的隐私保护可达声明握手协议（从单一声明数字恢复全可见性Oracle 95.9%的升级决策）。实验证明级联感知解决在四智能体工作流和大规模合成拓扑中实现了最高分辨率保真度。
AI.research_question: 在多智能体系统中，当多个治理策略（监管、组织、任务层面）产生冲突执行决策时，如何在系统级（而非单智能体级）视角下检测、估计和解决这些冲突，并最小化治理成本？
AI.motivation: 现有运行时治理框架将策略执行视为单智能体问题，忽视了治理决策被阻断后通过依赖关系传播引发的级联效应。当一个治理策略阻断一个智能体时，影响会通过依赖智能体传播，产生现有框架既无法建模也无法度量的执行级联。治理决策的真实成本通常是全局图级别的而非局部级别的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 策略冲突级联分类法（阻塞、矛盾、升级三种类型）、治理成本最小化框架、级联感知解决理论、对抗性压力测试理论
AI.method: 提出CARM（级联感知解决机制）：检测冲突、估计下游传播、选择已证明是治理成本精确最小化器的解决策略。扩展包括：（1）结果感知解决选择器，通过15000次合成试验进行对抗压力测试；（2）轻量级隐私保护的可达声明握手协议，跨组织边界扩展可达性估计。实验包含受控四智能体工作流和大规模合成拓扑扫描。
AI.findings: （1）CARM选择的解决策略是对治理成本的精确最小化，而非手工调整的规则；（2）结果感知选择器经15000次对抗测试证明不会发生永久工作流失败；（3）隐私保护握手协议从单一声明数字恢复全可见性Oracle 95.9%的升级决策；（4）级联感知解决在四智能体工作流和大规模合成拓扑中实现最高解决保真度，通过选择性升级高可达性、高严重性冲突给人审，最小化不可逆自动化失败。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出多智能体治理冲突级联的三类分类法（阻塞、矛盾、升级），为系统级策略冲突研究提供概念框架；（2）证明CARM的解决策略是治理成本的精确最小化器，为运行时治理提供了理论最优保证；（3）证明结果感知解决选择器下永久工作流失败不可能发生；（4）重新定义多智能体策略冲突的范畴——它既不是单智能体问题，也不仅是单一组织问题，而是系统级问题。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供CARM机制可直接部署于企业多智能体系统中，实现级联感知的治理冲突解决；（2）隐私保护握手协议使跨组织边界的可达性估计成为可能，仅需共享一个声明数字即能恢复95.9%的升级决策，兼顾隐私与效果；（3）通过选择性升级高可达性、高严重性冲突至人工审查，最大限度地减少不可逆的自动化失败。

title: How High Does the Fruit Hang? Structural Limits of Scientific Knowledge and Productivity

detail.title: How High Does the Fruit Hang? Structural Limits of Scientific Knowledge and Productivity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I decale no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The metaphor of picking the low hanging fruit is often invoked in the context of debates on the progress and productivity of contemporary science. It captures a core intuition that diminishing returns of scientific researchthe increasing difficulty of reaching scientific goalsare due to certain structural features of the tree of nature. The actual features behind the diminishing returns in science are rarely clearly identified and explored in detail, beyond the metaphor. I suggest that the core intuition may be correct and explanatorily very powerful once we identify the scaling of the physical and non-ergodicity of the living world as the relevant features. These features may also turn out to be long-term drivers of a wider innovation productivity crisis identified by economists, which cannot be fully or primarily explained or mitigated via institutional features.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"接近容易摘取的果实"这一隐喻，探讨当代科学进步与生产力递减现象。作者认为科学研究的边际收益递减源于自然界固有的结构特征——物理世界的尺度化规律（scaling）和生命世界的非遍历性（non-ergodicity），并进一步提出这些特征可能是更广泛的创新生产力危机的长期驱动因素，而这一危机不能仅通过制度性特征来充分解释或缓解。
AI.research_question: 科学研究的收益递减现象背后真正的结构性特征是什么？这些特征是否能够解释更广泛的创新生产力危机？
AI.motivation: "摘取低垂果实"的隐喻常用于讨论当代科学的进展与生产力，但其背后的实际机制很少被清晰地识别和深入探讨，作者旨在超越隐喻层面，识别出导致科学收益递减的具体自然世界结构特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文提出两个关键理论概念：一是物理世界的尺度化（scaling）规律，二是生命世界的非遍历性（non-ergodicity）。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析方法，通过对"低垂果实"隐喻的哲学与科学分析，提出将物理尺度化和生物非遍历性作为科研收益递减的解释框架。
AI.findings: 作者认为"低垂果实"的核心直觉可能是正确的，一旦将其与物理世界的尺度化规律和生命世界的非遍历性特征相联系，该隐喻将具有极强的解释力。这些结构性特征可能是经济学家所识别的更广泛创新生产力危机的长期驱动因素，且该危机不能完全或主要通过制度性因素来解释或缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"低垂果实"隐喻从模糊的直觉提升为具有明确理论基础的科学解释框架，将物理尺度化与生物非遍历性引入科学进步研究的解释体系中。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和科研管理者提供警示：创新生产力下降可能源于自然世界的深层结构性约束，而非单纯制度问题，因此仅靠制度改革无法充分扭转创新衰退趋势。

title: Derivatives on Compute: Pricing Theory and Market Design for AI Infrastructure

detail.title: Derivatives on Compute: Pricing Theory and Market Design for AI Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts

detail.abstract: Compute is incresingly becoming an important input into the economy, and in many sectors it has earned its place alongside energy or labor. Like other production inputs, compute is exposed to volatile price risks. However, compute also exhibits unique characteristics that distinguish it from traditional commodities and must be addressed. Despite this, no standardized derivatives market yet exists to price compute or hedge its risks. This paper closes the gap by developing the mathematical framework and market architecture for standardizing compute derivatives, enabling the pricing, hedging and transfer of compute risks. We argue that compute behaves like a non-storable service commodity akin to electricity or freight rather than oil, and make the economic case for such a market via classical hedging-pressure theory. We address the prerequisite of an observable reference price by defining a quality-normalized benchmark, the Compute Reference Unit (CRU), model the CRU price as a mean-reverting jump-diffusion, and then derive closed-form futures, swap, and option prices and a physical risk premium within an incomplete-markets framework. We further quantify, against real hardware pricing data, the residual hardware-specific basis risk that quality normalization via the CRU necessarily leaves behind, and derive a model-implied minimum-variance hedge ratio for it. Worked numerical examples illustrate the framework throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为计算力（Compute）这一日益重要的经济投入品构建了标准化的衍生品市场框架，提出了质量归一化的基准指数（CRU），并推导出期货、互换、期权等衍生品的闭式定价公式，为解决计算力价格风险的对冲与转移提供了完整的数学与市场架构。
AI.research_question: 如何为计算力这一新兴经济投入品建立标准化的衍生品市场，以实现其价格风险的定价、对冲和转移？
AI.motivation: 计算力已成为与能源、劳动力并列的重要经济投入品，且面临剧烈价格波动风险。然而，不同于传统大宗商品，计算力具有独特的属性（不可存储、服务型商品等），且目前市场上不存在标准化的衍生品工具来对其风险进行定价和对冲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典对冲压力理论（hedging-pressure theory）以及不完全市场框架下的衍生品定价理论。
AI.method: 本文采用理论建模方法：定义质量归一化的计算力参考单位（CRU）基准价格，将其建模为均值回归跳跃扩散过程，在不完全市场框架下推导期货、互换、期权的闭式定价公式及实物风险溢价；利用真实硬件定价数据量化质量归一化所遗留的基差风险，并推导模型隐含的最小方差对冲比率。
AI.findings: 计算力应被视为类似电力或航运的不可存储服务型商品而非石油类商品；在不完全市场框架下成功推导出期货、互换、期权的闭式价格解；基于真实硬件定价数据量化了CRU质量归一化留下的基差风险，并给出了最小方差对冲比率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将计算力纳入衍生品定价理论框架，为服务型商品衍生品定价提供了新的理论模型（均值回归跳跃扩散 + 不完全市场）；通过对冲压力理论为计算力衍生品市场的经济合理性提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算力衍生品市场的完整架构设计（CRU基准、衍生品合约设计），使计算力价格风险可被定价、对冲和转移，惠及云计算提供商、AI企业等重度依赖计算力的经济主体。

title: FEMA And Federalism: Risk Management, Climate Change, And The Case Against FEMA Abolitionism
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law

detail.title: FEMA And Federalism: Risk Management, Climate Change, And The Case Against FEMA Abolitionism

contentType.other: accepted for publication by DePaul Law review

detail.abstract: Recent calls by President Trump and others to eliminate or radically reduce the federal role in disaster response raise two key questions: Why is there a need for federal environmental, and how broad should that role be? This Article seeks to answer those questions. It highlights unique advantages of the federal government vis a vis the states in dealing with disasters.  These advantages largely take the form of economies of scale and scope.  Just as a reinsurance company can spread risks more broadly than any single insurer, so too can the federal government spread disaster costs more effective. By the same token, it can also plan more effectively and budget resources more efficiently for disaster response since the need for disaster resources is less variable on a national scale. Other advantages include greater budgetary flexibility, allowing it to spread extraordinary costs across budget years; greater learning-by-doing benefits from having to deal with a larger number of disasters; and the ability to redistribute costs from poorer states to national taxpayers. These advantages, which will be magnified by climate change, are most pronounced in dealing with the most severe disasters, but they remain significant for other disasters that states do not routinely encounter.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析联邦政府在灾害应对中的独特优势（规模经济与范围经济、预算灵活性、学习效应、成本再分配能力等），回应了特朗普总统等提出的削减联邦灾害应对角色的主张，论证了保留和扩大联邦政府在灾害管理中作用的必要性。这些优势在气候变化背景下将进一步放大，尤其在应对最严重灾害时最为显著。
AI.research_question: 为什么需要联邦政府在灾害应对中发挥作用？联邦政府的作用范围应该有多广？
AI.motivation: 特朗普总统等人提出要消除或大幅削减联邦政府在灾害应对中的角色，这引发了关于联邦政府是否有必要参与灾害管理以及其角色边界的关键问题，本文旨在回应这些质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模经济与范围经济理论（类比再保险公司的风险分散逻辑）、公共财政预算理论、组织学习理论（干中学效应）、成本分配与再分配理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（法学文论），通过理论论证和类比推理（如再保险模型）分析联邦政府相对各州的制度优势。
AI.findings: 联邦政府在灾害应对中具有多重独特优势：1）规模经济与范围经济使其能更有效地分散灾害成本（类似再保险公司）；2）国家级别的灾害资源需求变动较小，可更有效地规划和预算资源配置；3）更大的预算灵活性可将异常成本分摊到多个预算年度；4）通过处理更多灾害获得更大的干中学（learning-by-doing）效益；5）能够将成本从贫困州再分配给全国纳税人。这些优势在气候变化背景下会进一步放大，在最严重灾害中最为显著，但对各州不常见的中等灾害也依然重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将再保险经济学原理引入灾害应对的联邦主义理论分析框架，系统性地论证了联邦政府在灾害管理中的制度优势，为联邦主义与灾害法研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反驳削减联邦灾害应对角色的政策主张提供了系统论证依据，为政策制定者界定联邦政府灾害管理的合理角色边界提供了参考框架。

title: Europe's New Climate Reality: How Heat, Drought and Energy Stress Are Reshaping the European Economy Climate adaptation as a mechanism of capital reallocation across European industries

detail.title: Europe's New Climate Reality: How Heat, Drought and Energy Stress Are Reshaping the European Economy Climate adaptation as a mechanism of capital reallocation across European industries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent researcher and declares no conflict of interest, personal or financial, that could have influenced this study. No relationship with any organisation, industry participant, or third party has affected the research, analysis or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, surveys, interviews or experimental studies. It is a conceptual and evidence-based working paper based solely on publicly available institutional, academic and industry sources. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. The author prepared the paper entirely as an independent researcher.

detail.abstract: This conceptual and evidence-based working paper examines how climate adaptation is reshaping capital allocation across European industries. Rather than treating climate change primarily as a source of direct physical damage, it frames adaptation as an economic transmission mechanism through which rising temperatures, drought, energy-system stress and infrastructure constraints affect sector competitiveness and investment priorities. The analysis synthesizes publicly available institutional, academic and industry sources, including evidence from Copernicus, the World Meteorological Organization, the European Central Bank, the European Investment Bank, Moody's Analytics and selected market-research providers. It does not develop a new econometric model or proprietary dataset; instead, it offers a qualitative, sector-level framework for interpreting recent climate and economic evidence. The paper identifies six transmission channels through which climate change affects economic outcomes in Europe: cooling demand, electricity-grid stress, water availability, insurance markets, infrastructure and logistics, and labour productivity. These channels create differentiated sector effects, supporting investment in the heating ventilation air conditioning industry (HVAC), grid flexibility, energy storage, water technologies, climate-adaptive construction and climate-risk analytics while increasing pressure on agriculture, river logistics, energy-intensive industry, winter tourism and heat-vulnerable real estate. The central contribution of the paper is to show that climate adaptation is becoming a material driver of public and private capital reallocation in Europe, as investment shifts toward resilient infrastructure, energy flexibility, water systems and climate-adapted assets.

AI.tldr: 本文从概念和证据层面探讨气候变化适应如何重塑欧洲各行业的资本配置。文章将适应视为经济传导机制，识别出六个传导渠道（制冷需求、电网压力、水资源、保险市场、基础设施物流、劳动生产率），并论证气候适应正成为欧洲公共和私人资本重新配置的重要驱动力。
AI.research_question: 气候变化适应如何通过经济传导机制重塑欧洲各行业的资本配置和投资优先顺序？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将气候变化视为直接物理损害来源，缺乏从资本配置和行业竞争力角度理解适应机制的系统性分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以气候变化适应作为经济传导机制的理论视角，通过六个传导渠道（制冷需求、电网压力、水资源可用性、保险市场、基础设施与物流、劳动生产率）分析行业差异化影响。
AI.method: 质性、部门层面的框架分析，综合运用Copernicus、世界气象组织、欧洲央行、欧洲投资银行、Moody's Analytics等公开机构数据与行业来源，未开发新计量模型或专有数据集。
AI.findings: 六个传导渠道产生差异化部门效应：利好HVAC行业、电网灵活性、储能、水技术、气候适应性建筑和气候风险分析；同时对农业、内河物流、能源密集型产业、冬季旅游和易受热影响的房地产构成压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将气候适应视为经济传导机制而非单纯物理损害源的分析框架，为理解气候适应如何驱动资本配置转变提供理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和行业参与者提供识别欧洲气候适应投资机遇与风险的部门级定性框架，指导资本向韧性基础设施、能源灵活性、水资源系统和气候适应型资产配置。

title: ASEAN's Energy Future and Human Rights Accountability: Human Rights Obligations of State-Owned Enterprises in the ASEAN Power Grid

detail.title: ASEAN's Energy Future and Human Rights Accountability: Human Rights Obligations of State-Owned Enterprises in the ASEAN Power Grid

keywords: UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming, The George Washington International Law Review

detail.abstract: The ASEAN Power Grid ("APG") is a flagship regional infrastructure project intended to interconnect the electricity networks of all ASEAN member states by 2045. State-owned enterprises ("SOEs") dominate its generation, transmission, and financing, blurring the line between commercial actor and instrument of state power. This dual identity complicates accountability for human rights harms arising from APG-linked projects. This paper maps the accountability mechanisms currently available for such disputes, spanning domestic courts, regulators, and grievance channels; regional bodies and APG governance structures; investor-state arbitration; and international human rights institutions. It also examines comparable frameworks from other regional infrastructure and energy contexts, including the West African Power Pool, the EU Energy Community, and multilateral development bank accountability offices. The paper finds that existing avenues offer inconsistent, fragmented protection and are ill-suited to transboundary harms, risking erosion of public trust and the APG's political legitimacy. It argues that any viable reform must work within, rather than against, the ASEAN Way's norms of consensus, non-interference, and sovereign autonomy, rendering conventional supranational oversight bodies politically and institutionally unfeasible. Instead, the paper proposes two interlocking, ASEAN-compatible mechanisms: a regional mediation referral system directing APG-related disputes to existing national mediation institutes, and a regional access-to-justice arrangement enabling claims to be brought in any member state with a sufficient connection to the dispute.

AI.tldr: 本文考察东盟电网（APG）项目中因国有企业双重身份（商业行为者与国家权力工具）导致的人权问责困境，系统梳理了现有问责机制的碎片化与不足，并提出两个符合东盟规范（协商一致、不干涉内政、主权自主）的互补性机制：区域调解转介系统与区域司法准入安排。
AI.research_question: 东盟电网（APG）项目中，由国有企业主导的跨境基础设施项目所引发的人权损害，现有问责机制如何运作、存在哪些不足，以及何种改革方案在东盟政治规范约束下是可行且有效的？
AI.motivation: 东盟电网是旗舰性的区域基础设施项目，国有企业主导其发电、输电和融资，模糊了商业行为者与国家权力工具之间的界限，导致人权损害问责复杂化。现有问责渠道提供不一致、碎片化的保护，且不适用于跨境损害，威胁公众信任和APG的政治合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 东盟方式（ASEAN Way）规范框架，包括协商一致、不干涉内政和主权自主原则；多层级问责理论（国内法院、监管机构、申诉渠道、区域机构、投资者-国家仲裁、国际人权机构）。
AI.method: 法律与制度分析（mapping/制度测绘方法）：系统梳理APG相关争端可用问责机制，涵盖国内司法、监管与申诉渠道、区域机构与APG治理结构、投资者-国家仲裁、国际人权机构；并比较分析其他区域基础设施与能源背景的类似框架（西非电力池、欧盟能源共同体、多边开发银行问责办公室）。
AI.findings: 现有问责渠道存在不一致、碎片化保护，不适用于跨境损害，可能导致公众信任侵蚀和APG政治合法性受损；传统的超国家监督机构在东盟政治与制度上不可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证了在东盟方式的规范约束下，超国家监督机构在政治和制度上不可行，为跨境基础设施人权问责的区域适应性改革提供理论依据；提出两个相互关联的、符合东盟兼容性的问责机制设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出区域调解转介系统（将APG相关争端转介至现有国家调解机构）和区域司法准入安排（允许在与争端有充分联系的成员国提起索赔），为APG人权问责改革提供具体可行的制度方案。

title: Zeros of L-functions and Extended Generalised Gamma Convolutions
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Zeros of L-functions and Extended Generalised Gamma Convolutions
detail.abstract: Nakamura and Suzuki proved that the Grand Riemann Hypothesis for F in the Selberg class is equivalent to the innite divisibility of an explicit characteristic function on R built from the zeros, a central zero of multiplicity m0 appearing as a Gaussian component of variance m0. Their criterion lives on the critical line; Thorin's condition, that ξF (1 2)/ξF (1 2 + √ s) be the Laplace transform of a generalised gamma convolution, lives on the half line and cannot express a central zero at all. We show that both are readings of one criterion in Bondesson's class of extended generalised gamma convolutions: the Grand Riemann Hypothesis for selfdual F holds if and only if θ → ξF (1 2)/ξF (1 2 + |θ|) is the characteristic function of a symmetric EGGC law, which is then the innite convolution of symmetric Laplace laws indexed by the zero ordinates, with Lévy density Cramér's exponential sum over the zeros. Because EGGC admits a Gaussian component the criterion survives m0 > 0 after an explicit deation, supplying the Laplace-side counterpart that the central-zero theorem previously lacked. All the encodings follow from a single identity, x 2 / y(x 2 + y 2) = ∞ 0 e-vy 2 sin 2 (xv/2) dv. Two consequences point at a path. The Thorin measure at abscissa α has a closed form in ξ ′ F /ξF , from which the arithmetic hypothesis bF (n) ≥ 0 is seen to buy exactly the classical half-plane Re(s) > 1 and no more. At the centre, by contrast, the criterion becomes a Stieltjes moment problem: writing Sm for the even Taylor coecients of log ξF at 1 2 , suitably normalised, the hypothesis holds if and only if (Sm) is a Stieltjes moment sequence, equivalently two families of Hankel matrices are positive semidenite, equivalently a continued fraction has positive coecients. This formulation mentions neither the zeros nor the Euler product, and it is eective: (Sm) is the power-sum sequence of the numbers-(ρ-1 2)-2 , its Hankel determinants are sums of Vandermonde squares over subsets of the divisor, and its Hermite Sylvester signatures count the zeros on the line. From 200 Taylor coecients, with no zero located, we obtain |ρ1-1 2 | = 14.1347251417 and Re(ρ1) ∈ (0.38899, 0.61101) for the zero of ζ nearest the centre. Along the way we correct the treatment of the algebraic factors of ξF , exhibit a cusp-form L-function for which the transfer lemma fails above α = 1, and show that ξF (1 2)/ξF (1 2 + |θ|) is not a characteristic function when the lowest zeros lie o the line.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Selberg类中自对偶函数的Grand Riemann Hypothesis等价于某个对称扩展广义伽马卷积（EGGC）特征函数的无限可分性，将Nakamura-Suzuki的临界线判据与Thorin半线判据统一为一个框架，并将中心零点情形转化为Stieltjes矩问题，提供了一种不依赖零点定位或欧拉积的有效验证方法。
AI.research_question: 如何将Grand Riemann Hypothesis（GRH）统一表述为一个特征函数的无限可分性判据，使其既能处理临界线上的中心零点，又能提供有效的数值验证方法？
AI.motivation: 此前存在两个看似独立的GRH判据：Nakamura-Suzuki的临界线判据（能处理中心零点但仅在临界线上成立）和Thorin条件（在实半线上无法表达中心零点）。此外，需要一种不依赖零点定位或欧拉积的有效方法来验证GRH。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bondesson类的扩展广义伽马卷积（EGGC）理论、Stieltjes矩问题、无限可分分布理论、Selberg类解析数论
AI.method: 通过关键恒等式 x²/(y(x²+y²)) = ∫₀^∞ e^(-vy²) sin²(xv/2) dv，将所有编码统一起来；利用矩序列与Hankel矩阵正定性判定；运用连分数正系数等价条件
AI.findings: 1) GRH等价于θ→ξF(1/2)/ξF(1/2+|θ|)为对称EGGC律的特征函数；2) 中心零点情形可通过显式去涨（deflation）得到半线对应；3) 中心判据转化为Stieltjes矩问题，等价于两个Hankel矩阵族半正定或连分数正系数；4) 仅用200个Taylor系数，无需定位零点，即得|ρ1-1/2|=14.1347251417及Re(ρ1)∈(0.38899,0.61101)
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了Nakamura-Suzuki与Thorin两个看似无关的判据；将中心零点情形纳入EGGC框架；建立了GRH与Stieltjes矩问题之间的新联系；揭示了算术假设bF(n)≥0恰好等价于经典半平面Re(s)>1
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需定位零点即可验证GRH的有效计算方法；给出了Thorin测度在横坐标α处的闭式表达式；纠正了ξF代数因子的处理；展示了转移引理在α=1以上失效的反例

title: Dynastic Capital and the Inheritance of Social Advantage
affiliations: Cornell University - Department of Policy Analysis and Management, NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Economics and NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Economics

detail.title: Dynastic Capital and the Inheritance of Social Advantage
detail.abstract: We use population-wide Norwegian administrative data to examine how social capital is transmitted across generations. We construct a multidimensional measure of families' social position based on six dimensions: elite education, elite occupation, executive status, corporate elite, elite positions in top firms, and elite residential tract. Social capital is highly persistent across generations and strongly predicts children's long-run income and access to elite positions, even conditional on parental income, wealth, education, and cognitive ability. Horse-race regressions suggest that social capital is a distinct dimension of inherited advantage that is quantitatively as important as parental income and cognitive ability in shaping children's outcomes. Moreover, the influence of social capital grows over the life cycle, and reaching the very top of the income distribution typically requires both high inherited income and high inherited social capital. Accounting for social capital also meaningfully alters conventional estimates of income-based mobility, indicating that part of what is typically attributed to inherited income reflects the transmission of social position. Quasi-experimental evidence from adoption placements and parental lottery prizes suggests that these patterns primarily reflect environmental transmission rather than genetic inheritance or direct financial resources.

AI.tldr: 本文利用挪威全国行政数据，构建了基于六个维度的多维社会资本衡量指标，发现社会资本在代际间高度持续传递，并显著预测子女的长期收入和精英地位获取。即使在控制父母收入、财富、教育及认知能力后，社会资本仍是独立的继承优势维度，其重要性堪比父母收入和认知能力。准实验证据（收养安排和父母彩票奖金）表明这种传递主要反映环境传导而非基因遗传或直接财务资源。
AI.research_question: 社会资本如何跨代际传递，以及它在塑造子女长期收入和精英地位获取中发挥多大作用？
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要关注收入和财富的代际流动性，但忽略了社会资本作为独立的继承优势维度；需要识别社会资本是否代表超越收入和认知能力的、独立的代际传递渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论、代际传递理论、收入流动性理论
AI.method: 利用挪威全国人口行政数据，构建基于六个维度（精英教育、精英职业、高管地位、企业精英、顶级公司精英职位、精英居住区）的多维社会资本指标；采用世代回归（horse-race regressions）比较社会资本与收入、认知能力等变量的相对重要性；利用收养安置和父母彩票中奖作为准自然实验识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 1）社会资本在代际间高度持续传递；2）社会资本显著预测子女长期收入和精英地位，即使在控制父母收入、财富、教育和认知能力后依然显著；3）社会资本是与收入、认知能力同等重要的独立继承优势维度；4）社会资本的影响随生命周期增长；5）达到收入分配顶端通常需要同时具备高继承收入和高继承社会资本；6）考虑社会资本后会显著改变基于收入流动性估算的结果；7）准实验证据表明主要机制是环境传导而非遗传或直接财务资源。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将社会资本概念化为一个多维、可量化的代际传递维度，拓展了代际流动性的分析框架；揭示了社会资本作为独立于收入和认知能力的继承优势渠道的理论地位；修正了传统收入流动性估计中可能混淆社会资本传递与收入传递的问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别代际不平等的非货币性来源提供了实证依据；提示仅关注收入再分配或教育政策的局限性，需要更广泛地考虑社会网络和精英地位的传递机制；对理解精英阶层的再生产和社会流动性政策的有效设计具有借鉴意义。

title: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance
detail.abstract: I decompose stock returns into a duration-matched Treasury component, identified from monetary policy surprises, and a payoff component. Risk and returns rise much less with duration for stocks than for their matched Treasuries. Stock volatility is dampened by rate insurance: rates fall in bad times, so the bond inside a stock provides insurance against the stock's payoff risk. Expected stock returns are dampened because the insurance works in reverse: rates rise in good times, so stocks' payoff gains hedge the losses borne by investors holding net duration, notably government bonds when Ricardian equivalence fails. This framework helps reconcile positive bond premia with negative stock-bond covariance, sheds light on low-risk anomalies and the collapse of the value premium, implies that fiscal and monetary policy shape bond and equity premia, and motivates a two-factor model that jointly prices stocks and bonds. Rate insurance can even turn the price of long-run risk negative, explaining why long bonds beat long stocks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将股票收益分解为久期匹配的国债成分（由货币政策冲击识别）和支付成分，发现股票的"利率保险"效应使得其波动率和预期收益对久期的敏感度远低于匹配的国债，从而解释了股票与债券协方差为负、低风险异象、价值溢价崩溃等现象。
AI.research_question: 如何通过利率保险（rate insurance）机制来统一解释股票与债券的风险-收益关系、负的股票-债券协方差以及股票市场中的各类异象？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型难以同时解释正债券风险溢价与负的股票-债券协方差，以及在低风险异象、价值溢价崩溃和长久期债券跑赢长久期股票等现象中存在的矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率保险（rate insurance）理论，即利率在坏时期下降、好时期上升，使得股票内部的债券成分对其支付风险提供保险；同时结合李嘉图等价失效（Ricardian equivalence failure）来解释政府债券风险溢价的来源。
AI.method: 将股票收益分解为久期匹配的国债成分（通过货币政策冲击识别）和支付（payoff）成分，进行实证分解与资产定价分析。
AI.findings: 股票的风险和收益随久期的上升幅度远小于匹配的国债；利率保险机制压低了股票波动率和预期收益；该框架能解释正债券溢价与负股票-债券协方差的共存、低风险异象、价值溢价崩溃，并指出财政与货币政策塑造债券和股票溢价；利率保险甚至可以使长期风险价格为负，解释长债跑赢长股。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出利率保险这一统一理论框架，将财政货币政策、债券与股权溢价联系起来，为负的长期风险价格和股票-债券负协方差提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一个能联合定价股票和债券的两因子模型，为投资者理解资产配置、久期风险管理以及政策变化对资产价格的影响提供指导。

title: Greenhouse Gases Emission In The Midwest: System Approach To Policy And Planning Under Liability Rules
affiliations: Dr. Momtaz Begum University of Science and Technology and The Ohio State University

detail.title: Greenhouse Gases Emission In The Midwest: System Approach To Policy And Planning Under Liability Rules
detail.abstract: The issue of global warming poses a daunting public economic policy design challenge, which has received the attention of economic theorists, many of whom ha\e recommended emission mitigation option schemes based on the benefits and costs of mitigation, and the environmental consequences. Policy practitioners and the public are increasingly enthusiastic in curtailing the magnitudes of these gaseous emissions, in particular, CO: emitted by coal-fired electricity generation. In this, the generating companies and the end-users have joint interest in profit maximization. But have dichotomy in their related activities. Tradition, in both law and economics, suggests that companies should be made to pay the costs of the pollution either through assignment or enforcement of full liability — Polluter Pays Principles and. then pass these incurred costs on to the end-users by charging a higher rate per kWh of electricity they use. The results of the analytical investigation, in this thesis, which consists of three separate sections that attempt to put the issue in its proper context. ha\e demolished the full liability doctrine and suggested an intermediate liability dogma. The first Section demonstrates that the overall total of CO: emissions from selected sources namely, coal, petroleum, natural gas, landfill and nitrogenous fertilizer, were significantly greater in the Midwest region, as a paradigm for the United States, from 1990 to 1998. The energy sources that contributed major portions to these trends were where coal combustion dominated the trends, in each state except in Michigan, w here petroleum dominated the trend in 1998, .Although Ohio contributed most to the region’s overall total historical CO2 emission trends, it was placed only titled in per capita emission levels in 1998, whereas Indiana was placed first. Illinois was the largest emitter of both total N2O and CH 4 emissions over this period with only a few minor exceptions in 1998. In the second Section, a theoretical framework and a flexible empirical methodology for measuring the degree of liability, based on economic efficiency and equity measures, where classical liberal maxim, regulator) axiom and ethical aspects act as catalysts, reveals that parties in question, i.e., the generating company(s) and the end-user(s), should be liable for the externality dilemma. In other words, they should share the costs of the emission burdens that they create as results of their own acts. A finite number of intermediate liabilities were examined under a hypothesized federal CO2 emission statute. Under the prescribed liability dogma, the third Section provides a background for regulators and stakeholders in optimizing policy design, to meet the stipulated emission standards, and choosing the best strategy for CO2 mitigation, subject to a set of systemic constraints.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过分析美国中西部地区1990-1998年碳排放数据，从经济效率和公平两个维度出发，构建了理论框架和实证方法，论证了在CO₂排放外部性问题上，发电公司与终端用户应共同分担责任（中间责任原则），而非让公司承担全部责任（污染者付费原则）。
AI.research_question: 在CO₂排放外部性问题上，发电公司与终端用户应如何分担责任？全面责任（污染者付费原则）是否是最优的政策设计？
AI.motivation: 全球变暖问题构成严峻的公共经济政策设计挑战。传统的法律和经济理论主张通过污染者付费原则让公司承担全部污染成本，但这一做法是否在效率与公平上最优值得质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以古典自由主义准则、监管公理和伦理层面作为催化剂，基于经济效率与公平度量构建责任分担的理论框架。
AI.method: 论文由三个部分组成：第一部分实证分析1990-1998年美国中西部各州CO₂、N₂O和CH₄排放趋势；第二部分构建理论框架和灵活的经验计量方法，在假设的联邦CO₂排放法规下检验有限数量的中间责任方案；第三部分为监管者和利益相关者提供政策优化设计的背景。
AI.findings: 1）中西部地区的CO₂排放总量显著增加，煤炭燃烧主导排放趋势（除密歇根州1998年石油占主导）；2）俄亥俄州历史总排放最高但1998年人均排放仅列第三（印第安纳居首）；3）伊利诺伊州是N₂O和CH₄的最大排放者；4）发电公司与终端用户应共同承担排放负担的外部性责任，而非由公司单独承担全部责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 推翻了传统的全面责任（污染者付费原则）教条，提出了中间责任原则（intermediate liability），为外部性责任分担理论提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和利益相关者在设定排放标准、选择CO₂减排最优策略时提供了系统约束下的政策设计优化指导。

title: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
affiliations: Columbia University, Harvard University and Columbia University

detail.title: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
detail.abstract: We explore the welfare costs of the loss of animal life in a consequentialist total utilitarian framework that incorporates the intrinsic value of living beings through their sentience. Moral philosophy and neuroscience define sentience as the capacity for valenced experience. Observable performance on cognitive tests represents a conservative lower bound on sentience under plausible neuroscientific assumptions. We estimate the relationship between cognition and neuron counts to cardinalize sentience. We collect population and neuron data for a wide range of animal species, and aggregate them into a single welfare measure. Across a wide range of parameters, the aggregate sentience losses of animals in the past half century outstrip the sentience gains to humans from population growth by at least 10,000-fold. Breaking even in welfare terms requires assigning a correspondingly small welfare weight to animals. Including the benefits of economic growth to humans does little to change these overall welfare losses.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个后果主义的总功利主义框架下，通过神经科学和道德哲学中对"感知能力"（sentience）的定义，利用认知测试表现作为感知能力下限，并结合神经元数量与认知的关系来量化感知能力，进而估算过去半个世纪全球动物的福利损失，发现其远超人类人口增长的福利收益至少一万倍。
AI.research_question: 在总功利主义框架下，过去半个世纪中动物的感知能力损失（福利损失）与人类人口增长带来的福利收益相比，规模如何？人类经济增长带来的收益能否抵消这一损失？
AI.motivation: 传统福利经济学几乎只关注人类福利，忽视了动物作为具有内在价值（通过感知能力体现）的生命体所承受的福利损失。本文试图在功利主义框架下，将动物的道德地位纳入量化分析，探索其福利损失的规模及其对人类福利的抵消程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后果主义总功利主义框架（consequentialist total utilitarianism）；感知能力（sentience）概念——道德哲学与神经科学共同定义其为"带有价值属性的体验能力"；基于神经元数量对感知能力进行基数化（cardinalization）。
AI.method: 1) 利用道德哲学和神经科学定义感知能力；2) 以可观测的认知测试表现作为感知能力的保守下限；3) 估计认知能力与神经元数量之间的关系以实现感知能力的基数化；4) 收集大量动物物种的种群数量与神经元数据；5) 将其聚合成单一的福利度量指标；6) 进行广泛的参数敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 在大范围的参数设定下，过去半个世纪中动物的感知能力（福利）损失超过人类人口增长的感知能力收益至少10,000倍；要使福利达到平衡，需要赋予动物极其微小的福利权重；将人类经济增长的收益纳入考量后，整体福利损失几乎没有改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次尝试将神经科学对感知能力的客观度量引入道德哲学和福利经济学的量化分析中；2) 为功利主义框架下跨物种福利比较提供了一个可操作化的方法论路径；3) 将"感知能力"这一哲学概念与可观测的神经生物学指标（神经元数量）建立了量化联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了动物福利损失规模的量化证据，表明动物的福利损失在总量上远超人类收益；2) 揭示了即使把人类经济增长纳入考量，也无法弥补动物福利损失，提示需要重新审视人类经济活动对动物福利的代价；3) 为动物伦理和可持续性政策提供了经济学分析框架和实证基础。

title: Doubling Down on Distance: Rethinking Civilian Protections in the Era of Military Drones and Algorithmic Warfare
affiliations: Utrecht University School of Law

detail.title: Doubling Down on Distance: Rethinking Civilian Protections in the Era of Military Drones and Algorithmic Warfare
detail.abstract: This chapter explores the complexities of remote warfare, particularly focusing on the use of military drones and their impact on the concept of the civilian in conflict. Remote warfare, characterized by a 'light footprint' and geographic distance from the state deploying force, includes various methods such as airstrikes, intelligence sharing, and private contractor involvement. Drones, as versatile platforms for integrating surveillance and strike capabilities, have become central and indispensable to these modalities, but their use also fosters dehumanisation and contributes to the erosion of civilian protections. Drawing on legal and interdisciplinary perspectives, this chapter examines how the rise of military drones and the increasing datafication of warfare (including the algorithmic turn in warfare) have created greater distances in combat, undermining the legal framework safeguarding civilians. The final section argues for an 'un-undoing' of the civilian and calls for a rehumanized interpretation of legal obligations to better protect civilians in conflict.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了远程战争的复杂性，重点关注军用无人机及其对冲突中"平民"概念的影响。文章认为，无人机与战争数据化（包括算法转向）创造了更大的战斗距离，削弱了保护平民的法律框架，并呼吁通过"重新人性化"的法律义务解释来更好地保护平民。
AI.research_question: 军用无人机的兴起和战争的日益数据化如何影响冲突中平民保护的法律框架及"平民"概念本身？
AI.motivation: 远程战争以"轻足迹"和地理距离为特征日益普及，军用无人机将监视与打击功能整合，成为其核心手段。然而，无人机的使用助长了去人性化，并侵蚀了平民保护，亟需从法律和跨学科视角审视这一趋势及其后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与国际人道法框架；跨学科视角（涉及战争数据化与算法化转向）；去人性化理论对"平民"概念的批判性分析。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析与跨学科批判性论证，结合远程战争文献与无人机技术发展的论述，采用章节式理论论述。
AI.findings: 无人机和战争数据化加深了战斗中的距离感，削弱了保障平民安全的法律框架；应通过"解除平民概念的固化"（un-undoing）与重新人性化的法律义务解释，来强化对冲突中平民的保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 对国际人道法中"平民"概念提出批判性重构，揭示远程战争与技术数据化对法律规范的侵蚀机制，提出"重新人性化"法律解释的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律实践者和军事决策者提供关于如何更好保护冲突中平民的具体法律解释与操作建议，强调在远程战争背景下重新审视法律义务的必要性。

title: Two Types of Tertiarization: Household Demand, Production Networks, and the Rise of Services

detail.title: Two Types of Tertiarization: Household Demand, Production Networks, and the Rise of Services

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no relevant or material financial interest that relate to the research described in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The paper uses only publicly available aggregae data; no human subjects were involved and IRB approval was not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: I received no external funding for this research. No other party had the right to review the paper prior to submission.

detail.abstract: I measure whether the rise of services is ultimately supported by household consumption or by non-household demand through production networks, investment, exports, and government. Using harmonized input-output tables for 76 economies over 1995-2022, I attribute service value added to its ultimate domestic final-demand category and measure both the domestic-household orientation of each service economy in levels, R, and the household contribution to service-valueadded growth, H; all objects are current-price value-added statistics, and the tracing stops at the border (exports are a terminal category). The conventional service share does not reveal the type: it is negatively correlated with R, contains little incremental information about R conditional on income, and about four in ten tertiarization episodes are majority-household. Among the 65 economies whose service share rose over 1995-2018, 77 percent became less householdoriented; the share is 75 percent under a two-percentage-point material-change threshold. Yet the service intensity of household-supported production rises with income. The exact identity R = α C σ C /s S resolves the apparent contradiction: aggregate household orientation, α C , falls faster than household-supported service intensity, σ C , rises. A one-type benchmark generates service deepening but has no purchaser margin. A two-type extension reveals the missing margin: within countries, nonhomothetic demand and saving move the investment-supported share against the household-supported share, and the extension gives the condition for the reversal. The accounting analysis then uses the exact Leontief system to show when service deepening in production networks raises the service share while lowering R. I then map the service share and R exactly into six accounting-feasible components and use a Shapley decomposition to quantify their contributions. Among economies with materially rising shares, the combined production-system channels (production structure plus investment and export demand composition, summed within each economy) are allocated a median country-level share of 73 percent of the service-share rise and are the largest contribution in 80 percent of those economies, while the decline in household orientation is allocated overwhelmingly to the aggregate final-demand structure; changes in household-consumption composition push in the opposite direction but are outweighed. The service share records how much service activity exists, not which economic transformation produced it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用76个经济体1995-2022年的协调投入产出表，将服务增加值追溯到其最终国内需求类别（家庭消费、投资、出口、政府等），构建了家庭导向指标R和家庭对服务增长贡献指标H，发现传统服务业份额无法揭示服务业的"类型"——即服务业增长是由家庭消费还是非家庭需求（通过生产网络、投资、出口、政府）驱动的。研究表明约77%的服务份额上升经济体变得更加非家庭导向，但通过生产系统的渠道（生产结构加投资和出口需求构成）贡献了服务份额上升的73%。作者用精确的里昂惕夫系统解释了服务深化何时在提高服务份额的同时降低R，并用Shapley分解量化各渠道贡献。
AI.research_question: 服务业的崛起究竟是由家庭消费支撑的，还是由非家庭需求（生产网络、投资、出口和政府）支撑的？传统服务业份额指标能否揭示服务业增长的类型或驱动机制？
AI.motivation: 传统上研究者用"服务业份额"（服务产出占GDP比重）来衡量服务化进程，但该指标无法区分服务业增长到底是由最终家庭消费拉动还是由中间生产网络、投资、出口等非家庭需求拉动。这一区分对理解经济结构转型、供给侧与需求侧驱动机制至关重要，但现有文献缺乏系统性度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入产出分析（Leontief系统）与增加值追溯方法；两类服务导向指标（家庭导向R、家庭贡献H）；非位似需求与储蓄的两类型扩展模型；Shapley分解
AI.method: 使用76个经济体1995-2022年协调投入产出表，建立增加值追溯到最终需求的精确里昂惕夫系统。构建家庭导向指标R（服务业各最终需求类别的家庭份额）和家庭贡献指标H（家庭对服务业增加值增长的贡献）。通过精确恒等式R=αCσC/sS分解家庭导向变化；利用两类型扩展模型（家庭支持型与非家庭支持型）分析需求非位似和储蓄的作用；采用Shapley分解将服务份额与R映射到六个会计可行组成部分并量化各自贡献。
AI.findings: (1) 传统服务份额与家庭导向R呈负相关，且关于收入条件化后，服务份额对R几乎没有增量信息；(2) 约40%"服务化事件"以家庭需求为主；在65个服务份额上升的经济体中，77%变得更不家庭导向（两百分点阈值下为75%）；(3) 家庭支持型生产的服务强度随收入上升；(4) 恒等式R=αCσC/sS化解矛盾：家庭导向αC的下降快于家庭支持型服务强度σC的上升；(5) 在两类型扩展中，非位似需求与储蓄使投资支持型份额与家庭支持型份额反向变动；(6) 生产系统渠道（生产结构+投资和出口需求构成）贡献了服务份额上升的73%（中位数），且在80%的经济体中为最大贡献因素；(7) 家庭导向的下降主要归因于最终需求结构，家庭消费构成变化方向相反但被压倒。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出并精确度量了服务业的"家庭导向"维度，揭示了服务份额与服务增长类型之间的根本区别；(2) 建立精确的会计恒等式（R=αCσC/sS）化解了家庭导向下降与服务强度上升的表面矛盾；(3) 扩展了标准单类型结构转型模型，引入"购买者边际"（purchaser margin），揭示非位似需求和储蓄如何改变服务增长类型；(4) 运用Shapley分解提供了生产系统渠道与最终需求渠道对服务份额变化的精确量化贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为政策制定者提供区分服务业增长真实类型（家庭消费驱动vs.生产网络/投资/出口驱动）的方法论工具；(2) 提示决策者不能仅以服务份额高低判断服务化质量，需要关注家庭导向指标；(3) 为理解不同经济体服务化路径差异（如生产网络深化、全球价值链参与）提供实证依据。

title: Overnight Corporate Bond Trading
affiliations: Texas A&M University, Texas A&M and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School

detail.title: Overnight Corporate Bond Trading
detail.abstract: Corporate bond trades executed between 6:30 p.m. and 8:00 a.m. (ET) are not publicly disseminated until after TRACE reopens, generally between 8:00 and 8:15 a.m., creating a recurring interval of delayed post-trade transparency. Using enhanced TRACE data, we study how this temporary opacity affects trading and price discovery in the corporate bond market. Overnight trades are substantially larger than intraday trades and contribute disproportionately to price discovery. Overnight order imbalances predict future returns for both the same bond and other bonds issued by the same firm, indicating that overnight trades contain issuer-level private information. The price impact of overnight trades is significantly stronger and more persistent than that of intraday trades. Overnight activity is also more concentrated among large dealers and associated with higher dealer spreads and worse receiver outcomes. Finally, TRACE dissemination expansions increase overnight trading activity, suggesting that informed traders strategically shift trading toward periods with delayed disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用增强版TRACE数据，研究了公司债券市场中隔夜交易（下午6:30至上午8:00）因延迟公开披露而导致的暂时性信息不透明如何影响交易和价格发现。研究发现隔夜交易规模更大、对价格发现贡献不成比例地高，包含发行主体层面的私有信息，价格冲击更强更持久，且知情交易者会策略性地将交易转向延迟披露时段。
AI.research_question: 公司债券市场中延迟的交易后透明度（隔夜交易的暂时性不透明）如何影响交易行为、价格发现和信息传递？
AI.motivation: 公司债券的交易后透明度并非连续实时的——隔夜交易存在约8至15小时的信息披露延迟窗口。这种周期性短暂不透明为检验透明度对市场质量影响的自然实验提供了独特机会，但此前缺乏对隔夜公司债券交易的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论，包括价格发现理论、私有信息交易理论、透明度与市场质量理论。
AI.method: 使用增强版TRACE数据，比较隔夜交易与日内交易的特征差异；通过价格发现贡献分析、订单失衡对未来收益的预测回归、价格冲击的持久性分析以及TRACE披露扩展前后的对比研究来检验假设。
AI.findings: （1）隔夜交易规模显著大于日内交易，且对价格发现的贡献不成比例地高；（2）隔夜订单失衡能预测同一债券和同一发行人其他债券的未来收益，表明包含发行主体层面的私有信息；（3）隔夜交易的价格冲击更强且更持久；（4）隔夜活动更集中于大型交易商，与更高的交易商利差和更差的接收方结果相关；（5）TRACE披露扩展增加了隔夜交易活动，表明知情交易者策略性地转向延迟披露时段。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究公司债券市场中周期性延迟交易后透明度对价格发现和交易的影响；揭示知情交易者如何策略性地利用披露延迟窗口；扩展了关于交易后透明度和信息交易的市场微观结构文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估TRACE披露制度设计提供实证依据；揭示延迟披露窗口可能被知情交易者利用的机制，为优化信息披露时间安排提供政策参考。

title: Pricing the End of Stationarity: Catastrophe Reinsurance and the Limits of Insurability

detail.title: Pricing the End of Stationarity: Catastrophe Reinsurance and the Limits of Insurability
detail.abstract: Climate policy increasingly relies on the monetary valuation of ecological risk, yet the institution with the longest record of pricing climatic hazard, property-catastrophe insurance and reinsurance, is withdrawing from the frontier where that hazard is growing fastest. This paper asks what the retreat reveals about the conditions under which money can translate ecology at all. Drawing on Knight’s and Keynes’s risk–uncertainty distinction, Davidson’s ergodicity critique, and Orléan’s theory of conventional valuation, it reconstructs insurability as a monetary convention: the institutionally stabilized projection of past loss frequencies onto the future, materialized since Hurricane Andrew in vendor catastrophe models that manufactured a stationary stochastic representation of nature against which annual contracts could be written. Climate non stationarity dissolves the premise of that projection. The paper reads the 2017–2026 market record (a 27.5 per cent single-year price increase followed by a 16 per cent single-year decline against record losses; capacity withdrawal from wildfire-exposed California and Florida wind; nineteen fold growth of residual-pool policies in the highest-risk areas; a protection gap near half of global losses) as the separable signatures of a convention under strain: prices obeying capacity and confidence, quantities registering local collapse. Securitization deepens the capital behind the convention while narrowing its epistemic base to the model output itself; what the convention releases migrates to public balance sheets, the one form of risk absorption that does not presuppose stationarity. Insurability, the paper concludes, is the best case for pricing nature, and its frontier is retreating: monetary valuation of ecological processes presupposes the very stability that ecological crisis removes, and adaptation ultimately rests on political institutions for distributing uninsurable loss.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析财产巨灾保险/再保险市场2017-2026年的撤离记录，揭示了"可保性"作为一种货币惯例的本质：它将过去损失频率稳定地投射到未来，而气候非平稳性瓦解了这一前提。市场数据（价格剧烈波动、容量撤离、残留风险池膨胀、保障缺口）是可保性惯例承压的分离性标志，最终结论是货币化生态过程预设了生态危机所移除的稳定性，适应最终依赖政治制度来分配不可保损失。
AI.research_question: 财产巨灾保险（定价气候风险最悠久的制度）从气候灾害增长最快的前沿撤离，这揭示了什么条件下货币才能"翻译"生态？
AI.motivation: 气候政策日益依赖生态风险的货币估值，但最擅长定价气候危险的机构（财产巨灾保险/再保险）正在从风险增长最快的前沿撤退，这一矛盾为审视货币估值生态的前提条件提供了独特窗口。
AI.theoretical_framework: Knight和Keynes的风险-不确定性区分、Davidson的遍历性批判、Orléan的惯例估值理论（conventional valuation）。
AI.method: 将可保性重构为一种货币惯例的理论分析，并结合2017-2026年的市场记录数据（价格指数、容量变化、残留池保单数、保护缺口）进行实证解读。
AI.findings: （1）2017-2026年市场呈现可保性惯例承压的分离性标志：价格服从容量与信心，数量记录局部崩溃；具体包括27.5%单年价格暴涨后16%单年下跌、加州野火和佛州风灾的容量撤离、高风险区残留池保单19倍增长、全球损失近半的保护缺口。（2）证券化深化惯例背后的资本，却将认知基础收窄到模型输出本身；（3）惯例释放的风险转移到公共资产负债表——这是唯一不预设稳定性的风险吸收形式。（4）可保性是对自然定价的最佳案例，但其前沿正在撤退。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可保性重新理论化为一种"货币惯例"，以风险-不确定性、遍历性批判和惯例估值理论为基础，揭示货币化生态过程所预设的稳定性前提，丰富了关于货币估值生态可能性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出适应不可保气候损失最终依赖政治制度（公共资产负债表与分配机制），而非市场化的保险定价，为气候政策与风险治理实践提供方向性启示。

title: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia
affiliations: University of Massachusetts at Amherst - College of Social and Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and University of Essex

detail.title: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia
detail.abstract: Over nearly two centuries, US inventions have become increasingly dissimilar: not just fewer head-to-head collisions between inventors, but growing distance between neighboring inventions. We document this secular decline in similarity using validated neural language models applied to the full text of claims in over 11 million US patents (1836-2023), corroborated by a 98% decline in patent interference rates, a measure of independent simultaneous invention. Measuring this correctly requires validation, since different representations of the same patent text can yield opposite conclusions about whether inventions are converging or spreading out. Our validation framework, the first systematic comparison for patent text, selects among these representations. We develop a spatial competition model in which inventors choose locations in idea space. The model explains spreading out and connects it to several independently documented patterns-rising R&D investment per inventor, increasing patent values, weakening knowledge spillovers, and declining research productivity. The mechanism is spatial; as inventors spread out to capture new territory, inventions become more valuable but also more costly for others to absorb. In doing so, the model turns spillover intensity, innovation step size, and research productivity from fixed primitives into outcomes of inventor positioning. A calibrated decomposition attributes roughly 40% of the long-run decline in US research productivity to these spatial forces, alongside traditional explanations such as fishing out and the burden of knowledge. Where inventors stand relative to each other in idea space matters as much for growth as how many of them there are.

AI.tldr: 本文利用神经网络语言模型对1836-2023年间超过1100万项美国专利的权利要求全文进行分析，发现美国发明在思想空间中日益分散化。作者构建了空间竞争模型，将发明人选择思想空间位置的行为与R&D投资上升、专利价值增加、知识溢出减弱和研究生产率下降等现象联系起来，校准分解表明空间力量解释了美国研究生产率长期下降的约40%。
AI.research_question: 美国发明在思想空间中的相似性是否随时间下降？发明人之间的空间定位如何在宏观层面影响研究生产率？
AI.motivation: 已有研究忽视发明人在思想空间中的相对位置对宏观增长的重要性。现有文献要么关注发明数量，要么将知识溢出、创新步长和研究生产率视为固定前提，而忽略了发明人空间选择的内生性。此外，不同文本表示方法对发明收敛或发散可能得出相反结论，亟需系统的验证框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间竞争模型（spatial competition model），发明人在思想空间中选址；基于神经网络语言模型（neural language model）的专利文本表征方法。
AI.method: 使用经过验证的神经网络语言模型对超过1100万项美国专利（1836-2023）的权利要求全文进行嵌入分析，测量专利间相似度的长期趋势；以专利冲突率（interference rate）下降98%作为独立佐证；开发第一个系统的专利文本表征验证框架；构建并校准空间竞争模型进行分解分析。
AI.findings: （1）近两个世纪以来，美国专利的相似度持续下降——不仅发明人之间的正面竞争（head-to-head collisions）减少，相邻发明之间的距离也在扩大；（2）专利冲突率下降了98%，印证了独立同步发明现象的显著减少；（3）发明人分散化与R&D投资上升、专利价值增加、知识溢出减弱和研究生产率下降等模式密切相关；（4）空间力量解释了美国长期研究生产率下降的约40%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将知识溢出强度、创新步长和研究生产率从固定前提（primitives）转变为发明人空间定位的内生结果；建立空间分散化与宏观生产率下降之间的理论机制；提出首个针对专利文本表示的系统验证框架，为后续研究提供方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和应对研究生产率下降提供了新的视角——发明人在思想空间中的相对位置与发明数量同样重要；对R&D资源配置、创新政策制定和知识产权管理具有启示意义。

reference: University of Chicago Law Review Online (forthcoming).
title: The Polluter-Pays Principle and its Enemies: Corporate Fraud, Weaponizing Preemption, and the Survival of Climate Accountability
affiliations: and George Washington University -Law School

detail.title: The Polluter-Pays Principle and its Enemies: Corporate Fraud, Weaponizing Preemption, and the Survival of Climate Accountability

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law Review Online (forthcoming).

detail.abstract:
State and local governments across the United States have filed suit in state courts against major fossil fuel companies, seeking compensation for climate-related damage to their infrastructure, public resources, and communities. These suits allege that the defendant companies knew for decades that their products were driving catastrophic climate change, concealed that knowledge, and ran sophisticated deception campaigns to protect their profits. The companies and their supporters contend that the Clean Air Act and the Constitution foreclose the claims. The Supreme Court's grant of certiorari in Suncor Energy, Inc. v. Board of County Commissioners of Boulder County will require the Court to decide whether these preemption arguments succeed.

This essay argues that they clearly do not. The Clean Air Act's savings clauses affirmatively preserve state remedies, and American Electric Power Co. v. Connecticut expressly left the state-law preemption question open; the presumption against preemption in this area of traditional state authority applies with full force and has not been rebutted. Neither the Act's text, nor its occupation of any field, nor any conflict with its objectives forecloses state common law claims for climate-related harm—from nuisance, negligence, and trespass to fraud and concealment. The claim that the Constitution's allocation of foreign affairs authority to the federal government preempts such suits misreads relevant precedent, has no limiting principle, and has been rejected by the courts that have considered it. And the fraud and deception allegations at the heart of many of these suits are further still from any basis for preemption: they address conduct the Clean Air Act does not regulate and that no federal statute has ever been held to preempt.

The essay also advances several arguments that the parties' briefs do not reach. First, damages and locally confined relief lack the extraterritorial reach that alone could justify centralizing authority over emissions. Second, the Trump Administration's 2026 rescission of the greenhouse gas endangerment finding removes the regulatory predicate on which the "speaks directly" rationale, and thus the preemption theory, depends. Third, after Loper Bright, courts owe no deference to any agency claim that federal inaction preempts state law. Finally, preserving overlapping state and federal authority provides significant governance benefits. Communities that have endured the costs of climate harm—caused by corporations that allegedly knew the consequences and hid them—are entitled to their day in court. The Constitution simply does not shield polluters from paying for the harms they cause.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国各州与地方政府针对化石燃料公司提起的气候损害诉讼不应因联邦优先(preemption)而被驳回。作者认为《清洁空气法》的保留条款、宪法外交权分配以及Loper Bright案后的司法审查标准均不支持优先适用联邦法，州法侵权主张（妨害、过失、欺诈等）应当得以在州法院审理。
AI.research_question: 州与地方政府针对化石燃料公司提起的气候相关损害诉讼，是否应因《清洁空气法》或宪法对外交事务的联邦分配而被联邦法优先（preemption）从而被驳回？
AI.motivation: 美国最高法院已受理Suncor Energy案，将必须决定联邦优先抗辩是否成立，直接关系到各州气候诉讼的存亡。这是决定各州能否通过司法途径追索气候损害补偿的关键司法时刻。
